title: Montserrat with Cogwheel train, Tasting in a Boutique Winery with Tapas or Lunch
description: Visible from Barcelona, Montserrat makes for an obvious day trip—both for its religious significance and its culinary tradition. A cogwheel train handles the hairpin curves on the way up to the summit, and your guide makes sure you see the best of each site. Plus, this tour includes a visit to Montserrat Monastery and a 10th-century wine cellar with wine tastings and food pairings. A tapas-style or 3-course lunch is also provided for your convenience.

reviews.usertext:
Montserrat is a beautiful and unique location; our guide Lorena was just amazing! She was funny, engaging, took great care of the fairly large group and really knew her stuff. She was an expert on the area and included many fun and different facts about our various stops.
The luncheon provided at the winery was incredible and the staff was attentive and pleasant. Finally, the wine tasting and the wine room were excellent. Overall, we had plenty of quality time at each stop, the tour flowed really well and it was definitely a great value for the price.
Thanks Lorena for making this such a great and memorable day!

We really enjoyed our trip to the hillside historic and religious site of Montserrat. The cathedral was one of the most beautiful I have ever seen, and there ate several modern pieces of art inside that are stunning Our guide, Pul, did an excellent job of explaining the history of the area and the monastery. He was very interesting to listen to. For the lunch and winery portion of the trip, we took a bus for about half hour and switched to a different guide. She was also very knowledgeable. The winery was located in a castle dating back over 1,000 years, owned by the same family for all that time. The wines were very good. We tasted two whites and two reds. The reds were particularly delicious, in my opinion. I would have bought a half case to take back to the States if the shipping hadn’t been $120! The lunch was not as good but that’s usually the case with a large group lunch. It was certainly decent. Overall, I definitely recommend this excursion as very enjoyable for anyone with an interest in nature, history and wine.

My husband and I had an exceptional experience with Nerea on the Wine Tour. From the check-in to the end, she was very caring and personable to everyone on the tour, inclusive and made sure everyone felt taken care of and included in the experiences on-site, asking if she could take pictures for people, explaining the wine in detail, the history of Barcelona and the winery, and just the perfect personality for a guide. The most important piece was she was so genuine, we felt she enjoyed her job and showing tourists the experience which showed in how she treated us. I very much would recommend the tour but especially Nerea as she is the one who made the whole experience special, fun, and unique.

Thank you!
Elaine and Tom from New York City

Definitely add this visit to your itinerary. Overall trip was about 1 hour from Barcelona. I wish I could remember her name but the tour guide gave interesting facts on the way there along with punny jokes. Montserrat was beautiful. As soon as you arrive you can feel that you are in a truly holy/spiritual place. I liked that throughout the tour we got to do a little bit of everything including hike, view architecture, food tastings, and of course drink wine. JAVI was our tour guide and I can’t say enough nice things about him. He made the tour interesting and fun. His English was great and was very knowledgeable. Javi was personable and made our trip extra special. He even recommended an amazing empanada place in the city, which we loved. The winery was beautiful. Small and quaint with a romantic personality. Almost all the wine to take home was affordable and loved that it was organic and extremely low in sulfites. The only reason why I gave the tour a 4/5 was because of the meal that was served. The gazpacho was actually one of the better ones I tried while in Spain. The chicken with asparagus was underwhelming as well as the cake that was served. Although we enjoyed our time I think I would have opted just for the tapas. The group we went with was a fun bunch and everyone got along well. I think there’s something for everyone on this tour and I would highly recommend this to a friend if they were visiting Spain.

I would rate my experience a 10. Our tour guide Javi was polite, energetic, very knowledgable and willing to answer any questions. He did a fantastic job providing clear instructions to keep us on time, and provided us with many options for our free time and exploring at the monestarry. We chose the meal option and the food at the winery was delicious. Javi's knowledge of the family and legacy of the Oller de Mas winery truly showed his expertise. I have to commend Javi for his professionaliam while dealing with two truly RUDE and unreasonable members of our tour group. Despite their constant demands Javi still managed to make the rest of us in the 20 person group feel taken care of and happy. If I could rate him a 20 out of 10, I would. Truly enjoyed the experience and the other guides with castle experience were friendly and helpful even to those of us not assigned to their group.

I chose the full day Montserrat and winetasting experience as it gives you a lot more time at the monastery to explore all the amazing features. Our tour guide was Violetta. She was very knowledgeable, very sweet and charming and also had playful sense of humor. Her warmth and kindness won us all over and we were all very comfortable and enjoyed ourselves during the entire experience. The tour starts with an extended period of time in Montserrat and the monastery that is there. Violeta took us into the monastery courtyard and explained the history of the monastery including information about the monks and the boys who come there to be in the choir. Unfortunately the day we were there was the one day that the choir did not sing. But hearing the church bells ringing throughout the complex was amazing! And the tour inside the church was wonderful. after that Violetta let us continue exploring the monastery complex on our own for 2 1/2 hours and they were many wonderful things to see. At 1:30 we all met and got on the bus and headed for the thousand year old family run winery outside of Manresa. We were served a delicious three course lunch and got to try some of the wines. Then Violeta let us into the tasting room and we got to try a white wine and two red wines. They were all quite good. Violeta also explained that the winery and castle, which was built 1000 years ago by the original famly patriarch, Have been continuously run by the same family for over 26 generations. Pretty cool! At the end of the wine tasting there was time to purchase wines and also to enjoy another glass of wine in the courtyard before we departed back to Barcelona . Highly recommend!

This is a great way to get to Monserrat if you have one day to do it. The company offers a variety of different tours; we ended up on this one purely because of availability. Gus, our tour guide, was both knowledgeable and entertaining, and we have nothing but positive feedback for him. His breadth of knowledge, both of Monserrat and of the region and the region’s wines, is impressive. We typically do things on our own, but when you’re in a city, without a car (or a desire to drive in that city), tours like this are often the best way to see and learn about a place. We highly recommend this option when in Barcelona.

Anays and Ursula were our favorites! They were both well versed and very knowledgeable, not only when it came to the montserrat or winery, but they were able to confidently share tidbits of history as we traveled through different regions on the air conditioned tour bus as well. Anays even opted to throw in some much needed humor after a long day, not Ellen Degeneres funny, but nevertheless it kept a light mood throughout the tour. Ursula has a clear passion for wine and it’s development over the years; She was quite the sommelier when it came to visiting the vineyard and made the tapas & wine tasting worth every penny :)

My wife and I visited Barcelona as part of a European cruise and touring vacation. During the course of our trip we took guided tours pretty much every day – all of which were very good. Our tour with Nerea to Montserrat was outstanding and the very best of all of the guided tours we took. We liked every aspect of the program which was extremely well organized and provided an excellent variety of content. We rate the Montserrat with cogwheel train & wine experience at 10+ and Nerea, our guide, at 10++. The next time we are in Barcelona, we will be sure to join Nerea Castleexperience for another tour.

This trip was nothing short of amazing. English spoken guides with plenty of personality to say the least. We meet at the Hard Rock Cafe and immediately the energy was fantastic. All boarded a bus and the journey started there. About a one hour trip to Monserrat mountain and Toni our guide provided us with a fun history lesson along the way. After arriving in Monserrat we as a group walked together for about 1hr and then provided free time to wonder on your own and experience the local vendors and shops. We then boarded the bus for another hour trip down the mountain filled with laughter and more history. Our next stop was a beautiful winery own by a family since 946. We had the lunch option and sitting us at a of 8 it allowed us to talk to the others in the group which I personally found heart warming. Friends from Singapore and others from France! After have a vegan option or I had chosen the duck and potato we then walked on through the grounds on the winery and sampled some of the best organic wines in the region. This place was gorgeous and being it’s now sunset the amount and beauty of pictures made the trip again 5stars! Around 6p we boarded the bus back to Barcelona and just in time for a nap. I must say this trip needs to be on your bucket list when visiting Barcelona and you won’t be disappointed.

Ryan P. ( Hershey Pa. US)

The tour was amazing. Our tour guide Toni made great suggestions on how to best spend our time and even places we can eat and drink in the city. He made our tour very fun and memorable. Will definitely suggest it to friends. Thank you.

Montserrat was absolutely breathtaking. Our guide, Viioleta, was very knowledgeable, and she was able to help us bypass some ques so we could see things before big crowds. This was also very helpful at the winery. She and the other guides tended to the outdoor bar area of the winery, and at the cash registers to get us through quickly. It was an amazing experience and a must do when visiting Spain.

My neices and I had a wonderful time on the tour. 

The guides on the bus were the perfect mix of informative and fun without being over barring.

Marta is a lovely knowledgeable guide. Very accomodating and attentive, our group were a wide variety of ages and she perfectly executed managing all our different personalities.

Winery was beautiful and elegant. Lunch was devine and wine excellent

I was also impressed that Marta completed the wine tasting as well her knowledge and passion were evident.

In all an A++

This was the first tour we have been on in Barcelona and I do not know how it will be topped. First of all Marta, our tour guide, was very welcoming and broke the ice between the group. The bus ride to Montserrat was in a very nice bus with great commentary along the way. Once at Montserrat, Marta was extremely informative on the history and legend of the area. The only complaint for the whole trip would be that there was not enough time at Montserrat. From there we went to Oller del Mas winery. Once again Marta showed her knowledge and experience with the history and legend of the winery. The wine and Tapas were very good and again the only complaint would be that it went by too fast. The group was large but broken up into smaller groups so it was more personal. We highly recommend this trip to anyone wanting to visit Montserrat and have a liking for wine.

This day trip to Monserrat was a highlight to our trip in Barcelona!! When we arrived in Monserrat it felt like we entered a trans universe. The monestary was breath-talking, both the exterior facade and the detail of the interior. The cogwheel trip up to Monserrat was a once in a lifetime type of experience . We loved having some free time to do as we pleased. The short hike to the cross was well worth the panoramic view! Our next stop was the winery where we had a delicious three course authentic Catalonian meal with wine! Followed by more wine tasting (generous pours). The grounds of the vineyard we’re so scenic with the mountains of Monserrat in the foreground. Our tour guide Merak was fabulous, the perfect combination of knowledge and humor! 100% recommend this trip!

Booked the night before because plans fell through for Saturday - entered with no expectation but was looking forward to the cogwheel train ride up. It was impressive but Merak (our tour guide for the day) was excellent - both knowledgeable, approachable and had great entertaining stories with humor. The lunch was served in a very private elegant setting for our group and were served roasted duck with traditional Catalan sauce and sides along with a wine pairing of your choice. Outstanding. Wine tasting followed with a walk from the restaurant through the vineyards to a 1000 year old winery building. All around, was a full and complete day and very enjoyable. a very fair price for a great experience.

My and my partner are used to wine tours, but this was something else...

First, Montserrat is a magical place, you can't miss it. The day was foggy and at the beginning we felt like we just got unlucky, but our tour guide Luis Santana led us through the history of Montserrat with such enthusiasm and passion that he made us feel inside of a fairy tale.

Secondly, we got to the restaurant where we had a delicious 2 course meal. Our group got split in two tables and Luis was switching from one to another, making sure we were all having a great time.

Then we went to the winery, and our tour guide walked us through a beautiful vineyard explaining everything about the wine region, the varieties and the history behind Oller del Mas and answering all the questions our group asked him.

And lastly, Luis. NONE of the tour guides we've had in the past can compare to him. His knowledge, kindness, sense of humor and wit made "another tour to a winery" into an experience we will ALWAYS cherish.

Anays are truly amazing! She was a great storyteller from start to finish, and loved her jokes along the way. Truly a natural and made the tour an easy & exciting experience. I booked the tour to celebrate my and she did not disappoint.

Posting as the trip and details are fresh in my mind. The excursion was a great experience. Our guide, Jon, was knowledgeable beyond belief. He went over every part of the Montserrat and the surrounding area and we were impressed by his knowledge of the wines sampled that day as well. The views are unbelievable and breathtaking. And the walk up to the cross provided even better views.

The winery and it's history was also mind blowing. Again Jon explained and educated us on every part of the winery. The lunch provided was great and it was nice to get out of the heat.

We highly suggest this tour!

We were amazed by the Montserrat’s craggy peaks. The cog railway is an engineering marvel. The monastery is awe inspiring. We really enjoyed our guide Edu’s mix of interesting information and corny jokes. The cheese and honey vendors offer delicious local produce. However, the Oller Mas lunch break was disappointing. As wineries go, compared with Napa or any French chateau, this place is sad and lugubrious. The tapas are disappointing and dull, without imagination. Visitors would be better off making their own food choice,

This was a great experience. The cog train was a good way to see the views of the Spanish country side as it was slower than the bus. The monastery was beautiful and the Catalonian cultural significance of the site is definitely worth the time. The winery was beautiful and has a long family owned history that was very interesting. I’m not a wine connoisseur but the wine was very good with the opportunity to try an Orange wine if you chose to pay a little extra. The only additional cost on the trip is souvenirs, locally sourced goat and sheep cheese sold at the monastery, and additional wine if you so choice. Three glasses of wine are included. Prices for additional wine are reasonable between 3-11 euros a glass. Overall this was a great experience and our tour guide Jon was a wonderful guide with a wealth of knowledge on Spanish history and wine. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Barcelona.

Daniel was an excellent and entertaining tour guide. He was funny and knowledgable. With his background as a historian, he was able to share the rich history of not just Montserrat, but Spanish history and wine history as well. He kept our group motivated to make it back to meeting points on time but making sure we would have the best views during periods of transportation, sitting on the side of the train or bus with the best views. The wines were delicious and the food was great - the winery easily accommodated several dietary needs.

We had such an amazing time on this tour. Our guide Pol was fantastic. Super friendly, knowledgeable and most importantly, funny! The scenery was breathtaking and the vineyard they choose was perfection. If you want to get out of the city and try something a little different, I cannot recommend this highly enough. It was one of the highlights of our trip.

We loved the Montserrat tour and wine testing.  Overall, the whole tour went very smoothly with helpful guides paying attention to every details necessary for customer comfort. The bus and cogwheel train rides were comfortable. The sceneries from the train were gorgeous. Our tour guide Pep was outstanding.  He was informative, had a very good sense of humor and answered all our questions. On our return trip, we believe Pep went above and beyond to provide us additional guidance regarding our stay in Barcelona, interesting things to do, places to eat, etc.  We will strongly recommend Pep and Castleexperience Tours to our family and friends as well as use them for our future travels in the area.

The trip was absolutely wonderful and the guides were so committed and had such great attitude and service. Our guide was Toni and he was the best!
Within 5min of boarding the tour bus, the guides were giving us a summary of Barcelona's 2000 years of history within 25minutes and I think they did a brilliant job. The monastery on the mountain offered not only a fantastic peek into history but it was picture perfect as well. The views and sights you can expect is unparalleled and a small bonus is that we tasted many kinds of cheese at the small farmers market and 4 shots of the local liquor made with recipes from generations of monks. We ended off the tour on a high note with the visit to a beautiful vineyard and winery, now managed by its 36th generation of descendants, and got to taste a few local wines including its famed orange wine.

This tour was great! It was very easy to coordinate, and we had a wonderful time with good food and wine. The winery and town of Montserrat were beautiful. Our guide was Anays, who was an absolute delight. Her energy was so fun and welcoming, and the tour wouldn’t have been half as fun without her as our guide. She is so knowledgeable about the culture of Catalunya, but also about wine making and the winery itself. She also sent a long list of really good recommendations of different restaurants and activities around Barcelona after the tour, which I will absolutely be saving for my next trip! I would recommend this tour to anyone who enjoys wine, food, and a good time in more local scenes.

Service slow too much talking details were way over the top. They were supposed to be a four course lunch we only had three. Sampling for wine was supposed to be for we only had three. We were charged for a second glass of wine at lunch the food was terrible it was very very small portion the trip is not worth it

This tour was excellent. Our lovely guide Nuria was friendly and welcoming. She was knowledgeable and made the tour very enjoyable.

Montserrat is very small and there isn't loads to do but you only have an hour or so of free time (on the full day tour). You can go to the restaurant or museum and there is a short hike you can do. There was also free liquor tasting in the shop and a free sample of bread which was a nice little bonus.

The winery and vineyards are stunning and the tour was great. The lunch was delicious and was served in a small banqueting hall which was really nice. We got 2 glasses of wine with the meal then went to do the wine tasting which was 2 reds and a white. I just wished we had had more time to enjoy the bar on the terrace especially since the weather was gorgeous.

You can buy the wine in the shop and the prices are fair. I would have bought one but I only had hand luggage. I never felt like the guides were trying to sell the wine and the tour certainly didn't feel like an advert for it.

Overall it was a really great day and I would really recommend the full day tour.

Our guide Tony was great, he knew the history behind everything we saw and did. He was energetic, fun, made us all laugh and everyone really enjoyed the tour of Montserrat and the winery. I would recommend this tour and our guide Tony to all of my friends.

The trip to Montserrat was beautiful, and the scenery is breathtaking. Seeing the monastery was quite an experience, although the timing could have been extended to allow for some hiking along the bluffs. If you visit Barcelona, you must allow a day to do this trip.
Our guide Sergio was amazing, he is very knowledgeable and friendly, and relayed the history of the region in a fascinating way. He kept the pace for the tour, and did a great job pouring and discussing the wine at the vineyard.
The wine tasting felt touristy, although the people were very friendly there, when it came time to purchase the wine, the staff was very short and indicated the guide needed to complete the transaction, which took quite a bit of time, and delayed everyone in the group. This is the reason for the 4*. The food was okay, tapas was enough for us, so this worked out well, we did not get the lunch experience.
I would recommend this trip, just be aware of the difficulty with purchasing anything from the winery, they should have a special staff member to do this to make it easier.

A WONDERFUL DAY!
My family had an amazing day with this tour group. Everything was handled smoothly and professionally. We were lucky to have a quiet day at Montserrat we were told. Merak and Anais were amazing tour guides. Knowledgeable and funny! The Winery was very very wonderful. Good food and amazing wine! My young adults got a wonderful lesson in wine tasting and developed a new found appreciation for the grape. HIGHLY RECOMMEND. I have been to Montserrat before but this is definitely the way to do it!

The best part of the experience was the wine tasting and tapas. After walking around and seeing the sights of Montserrat mines tart we headed over to the winery. The tour guide anyways was amazing! So enthusiastic and a great guide. She knew so much detail about the wines and the process and even gave me a good recommendation for a bottle. The wine was poured as we were eating our tapas the whole experience was great. In fact she was great the whole way through. Montserrat had such a rustic charm! I would definitely recommend this trip to anyone.

This was an experience not to be missed. Toni was our tour guide and was excellent and informative. He went out of his way to help us secure tickets to get into listen to the choir at Montserrat. His knowledge of the region and his information about the lunch and the wines we tried were very informative. I recommend him and the tour unconditionally

Did not know what to expect, but from arriving at the bus station until our return, we were made very welcome and part of the group. Transfer to the cog wheel train was on a very modern coach, so no problem there. Mariana was our guide, although new to the role she was extremely friendly and knowledgeable. The view from Montserrat was amazing and time with plenty of time to explore. The trip down to lunch was around 30 minutes and the 3 course dinner with wine was fantastic. The wine tasting was good fun and educational. The whole day was amazing with fun and laughs along the way. Great to meet other parties from around the world.
Well done Mariana.

Great tour! Our tour guide was Jon. He was very informative regarding the history of the area.
The church was amazing, the Boys Choir outstanding sound was astonishing, bread and tasting of alcohol was a great additional as well. Unfortunately, there was not enough time to make it clear up the mountain top where the cross was positioned, we had to be at the meeting point at a certain time.
The food at the wine tasting was a great addition to the tour.
Let me not forget the views via the cogwheel train were just fascinating!!!
Great experience overall that my husband and my family will remember forever.

If you by any chance get Daniel your day is going to be great. We got Daniel and he was organized, friendly and really put us at ease as he guided us through the day. The best part was his humor anyone can give a dry informative tour but to make people enjoy the day is something special and Daniel has that.

Our guide, Mariana was very nice and knowledgeable. We also enjoyed the beautiful Montserrat. However, we did not like the wine tasting part. The TAPAS was very low quality compared to what we had experienced in other places in Barcelona. Also, the portions were very small. The wine was far from perfect and overall, I felt like we overpaid for the wine tasting experience. I would recommend Monserrat tour but not the wine tasting!

Montserrat was spectacular. Tour guides were knowledgable, engaging and interested in their customers. Wine tasting with Tapas was fun although would have preferred to see a little more of winemaking process. Do this trip for Montserrat not so much the winery.

We had a great cold wet day at the Montserrat monastery with our guide Narea. The bus was on time leaving Estacio Nord and after slight traffic in an hour we reached the Cogwheel station. The bus was comfortable but full with many groups. We easily reached the cogwheel train which went steeply and scarily up to Montserrat. Nadia gave us a good overview tour then we were on our own for over an hour. The bus picked us up at the monastery and we headed (nervously) down the other side of the mountain to a great winery, Ollay del Mas, where we enjoyed better weather, ate great tapas and tasted 3 wines. We then relaxed for 30 minutes then headed back to Barcelona, arriving at Nord exactly on time at 5 pm.

The entire tour was perfection! From the ladies working the front desk, the transportation staff, and the tour itself. What made our trip so special was definitely our tour guide, John! He was so knowledgeable and charismatic..he made our group of 8 feel welcomed immediately. We learned so much, and had a wonderful time exploring the basilica and winery. I’m 10/10 recommend this company and tour.

Marianna was such a Sweetheart and introduced us to all the loveliness of Montserrat and its wines. She is definitely a 10-10-10 !! She was instrumental in bringing us and other guests together; guests which we will stay in touch with for years. If we lived here, I would “adopt” her as our daughter !!! It was so obvious how much Marianna loves this country, this area. We fell in love with this area because of her joy, her knowledge, her guidance, and her friendship which she so easily established.

The overall trip was amazing and a beautiful little get away outside of Barcelona. The Monastery is beautiful and they give you plenty of time to explore and learn, then same goes to the winery. Food was great and tasting experience was amazing. its a small secluded but super old winery which was super neat to see. Our guide, Pep, was amazing and so much fun to talk with to learn more about the culture and history. He truly has a passion for this work and was so insightful and knowledgeable. Edu and Marianna were also super fun and energetic! Great trip and experience overall. Highly recommend

The trip was fantastic all thanks to Anays, our tour guide. She bring the experience to a whole new level as she is funny, interesting, knowledgeable and caring. Not the usual boring tour. Wines are great, view, scenery is awesome. Definitely worth every single cent.

Nerrea was an amazing guide, she provided just the right amount of information and it was very interesting. She had a great balance of time for our group, she memorized everyone’s name and joked around with my husband, Scott, which he got a kick out of since he was being silly. She was so knowledgeable I thought she worked for the winery. Her and her peer guides were so fun, we highly recommend this tour and our guide. She Rocked! Thank you.

It was a great day trip/tour and Merak was a very good Tourguide. The time in Montserrat was a bit short but enough to see the Monastery.
The Tapas lunch was tasty with a lot of local delicacies but we got just 2 glasses of wine and not really a tasting with diffrent wines. The history to it was very interessting.
For as it was a great escape from the big city and a fabulous day in the National Park.

This was the highlight of my recent trip to Barcelona! Anays was probably the best tour guide I've ever come across - she was energetic, enthusiastic and had a genuine passion for wine. The cogwheel train gave us awe-inspiring views over Catalonia, and Montserrat was absolutely beautiful (especially the main basilica). The wine afternoon was fantastic, and we were lucky enough to see the vineyard dog. I would highly recommend this tour if you're heading to Barcelona, and hopefully you'll be lucky enough to get Anays as your guide!

This was an all-around amazing experience. Our tour guides—and our particular group tour leaded Toni—were all attentive, funny, and energetic. Montserrat provided spectacular views, and there were quite a few things to do. We had 90 minutes to ourselves, and had to use the time wisely. Despite our best attempt, we missed a few things but still enjoyed the breathtaking views and shopping from the local vendors. The cheese and honey were particularly amazing. The winery was next, and we had three solid tastings of whites and reds. The tapas were a bit disappointing, which I suspect was due to our dietary restrictions. My wife and I are generally pescatarians and told the guides this beforehand, yet our main tapas plate was a salad (vegetarian) while others enjoyed several types of meat. That said, the transportation, communication, and energy the tour guides brought to this was wonderful. We highly recommend this tour with this company.

The trip to Montserrat is a beautiful way to escape the downtown hustle and bustle of Barcelona to see Catalunya in a different light. Everything from the bus ride to the train up the mountain was peaceful and majestic. The Basilica leaves you in awe and don’t forget to try the cheeses from the local farm stands! As for the winery on this tour- unfortunately this is why our trip gets 4 stars instead of 5. We did the tapas (not lunch) which was completely fine! However, the wine at the winery named Oller Del Mas, was a disappointment. The winery itself is lovely and full of fascinating history but the wine we sampled as part of our tapas pairing was not much to talk about. The white wine tasted like it wasn’t aged enough and no one at our table finished their two samplings of red.... The 2015 bottle of red wasn’t even sold in the store which leads me to believe they were trying to “get rid of it”. This wine region (and winery) is small, though- so not sure if it just so happened to be a rough season....

Our tour guide, David, was phenomenal and extremely passionate and enthusiastic! We enjoyed the history and comical cantor each step of the way! Definitely recommend this tour, but I advise the Castlewine tours to perhaps indulge its customers in an alternate winery or provide samples of other wines than those that we tasted today,

Very good trip - we were two couples who took this trip in early June as part of a small group of 20 or so. Very well organized, easy to find the tour office in Barcelona bus station. Nice drive to base of mountain on a bus that was not full - cog wheel train was worth taking. Plenty of time at the top (we did the optional walk to a great viewpoint) then on to the wine tasting which was fun. Tapas was basic but plenty of it. Good value and a great experienced guide in Pep Massons. Would recommend it.

Great tour with a great tour guide Marcil. Beautiful trip to Montserrat to see the monastery and ride the cog wheel train. After touring the Monestary we then took a short bus ride to the winery for a lunch with appetizer main course and dessert. Great time sharing the meal with people from the UK and Germany.
Marcil was our guide for the day and he was friendly funny and very knowledgeable. Would highly recommend this trip.
Shout out also to Aisha the other tour guide we met. Great job from a fellow New Yorker!

We loved our tour on March 5. Our guide Aina was excellent - very clear with lots of information, fun & easy to understand. She had a great sense of humor and explained everything really well. Instructions were clear and information was interesting. I would definitely recommend this tour to others traveling to the area!!! I would rate it a 10 out of 10! We also loved that it was a small group. My mother who traveled with me is 82 years old and the small group size made it easy for her to feel included and not be a burden to anyone. Aina did a great job of making sure everything was easy to access for her too.

As a tour guide myself in Bordeaux, France - I have to say that our experience was wonderful!! I am a tough critic and I love to see clear instructions, good interaction, personal experiences and at the same time knowing the guide is very knowledgeable. This had it all including lots of great suggestions for us to do during our free time up in Montserrat! Thanks again and when I return to Barcelona - I would love to do another tour!!

We did the tour to Montserrat with Cogwheel to top of the mountain followed by lunch and wine tasting at the winery. Everything was excellent. Our guide Marianna was great, she was very knowledgeable of the area and the wines. I would definitely recommend this tour and our tour guide.

My partner and I had the most amazing time. What a beautiful trip to finish your vacation in this beautiful country. Our tour guide was Gus. He was absolutely amazing and we were able to learn more about Monserrat and the history of winery. I highly recommend you this trip.

great trip, can highly recommend it for anyone who is interesting in wine, the culture and history of Montserrat region.
a lot of facts, interesting stories and a good portion of humor. and a great wine tasting at the end.

Wow! We had such an amazing tour with Nuria and loved every moment of our visit! Tour was great but they should have started earlier so that we could have more time in monteserrat. Guide was very nice. I recommend doing teh tappas, like us, since otherwise you spend a lot of time on the lunch. The tapps group returns to Barcelona like 1.5-2 hours before the lunch group.

We had a fabulous day with our guide Anays whose energy and stories quite literally brightened up the experience. The tour itself was phenomenal with a healthy balance of group and solo time. Our tour guide David was fantastic! He was friendly, funny, informative and made the entire experience quite enjoyable. Every aspect of this tour was great. The views are amazing. It was great to get out of Barcelona for the day and experience Montserrat. The wine and winery were wonderful. Ask about the wine vending machine.

We've spent a wonderful day and had a great experience. We left Barcelona by bus, then took a small train to arrive to Montserrat. After visiting Montserrat, our guide, Toni, gave us great ideas for spending our free time. In 1h30 we could do a little hike, that opnes a beautiful view on Monserrat and the mountains; a museum with masterpieces of the gretest painters; a local food market and even tasted the liquors made by the monks. It would be great to have some more of free time, as there are many things to do and 2 hours wouldn' bee too much. The part in the winery with wine tasting was also vey nice, Toni is a great guide, he gave us a lot of interesting information on the local wineries and sorts of wine. Wasn't sure what to expect from this tour, but it and our guide was fantastic! Our guide was fantastic, wish I could remember his name. The views and the monastery were breathtaking. This was a tour beyond our expectations! Our tour guide, Pol Salomó, was so knowledgeable and added so much to the tour. His knowledge of the site, wines and the history of Spain was remarkable. He also introduced us to a soft cheese with honey that is specific to Montserrat. Pol also gave us enough time on our own to explore. The lunch before the wine tasting was quite delicious of duck confit, potato and asparagus. We were also able to taste wines specific to the region and was even able to meet the vineyard owner! What a treat!! Overall, this is a fully day but well worth it. We hit recommend this tour and especially Pol!!

A well organised tour, which was really made all that more wonderful by Anays. Her English was impeccable with her great sense of humour & great knowledge. The scenery & time spent at Montserrat was great. The tapas & wine was very good, no scriming on quality or quantity.ĺ

Jon picked us up at our hotel for the drive to Montserrat. The visit to the Monastery was accented by a presentation of the boys choir; fantastic. Then on to the best part of the trip! Jon has a very good relationship with the winery owner so we were able to explore many parts of the winery. The owner is clearly passionate about her wines. We enjoyed them so much that we shipped a 6-pack home to the states. We can't wait until they arrive. This excursion is well worth your time.

Looking for something to do in between getting off a cruise ship and flying home late at night - this tour hit the mark on all fronts.
A thoroughly enjoyable day experiencing a diverse range of transport (coach, cog wheel railway, funicular & foot), sightseeing, visiting the Basilica and wine tasting with tapas.
The day was very well planned with thought given to, not just going up and down the mountain the same way, but a wider panoramic view of the whole of the mountain as we travelled back down to the winery on a different route.
Nuria our guide was brilliant - so knowledgeable, friendly and thoughtfully attentive - I cant recommend her highly enough.
Great way to end a holiday and the tapas option had us back in Barcelona city centre for 5pm (ideal for our flight).

I had a great time on my tour with Lorena! She was very knowledgable and kept my interest the whole day. Thank you for a great day!

We did a 9 hour Montserrat tour with lunch and wine tasting, our tour guide Merak was the best! He was so nice and so helpful and made the whole experience so much better. It’s absolutely beautiful views and delicious food. Definitely worth it!

The tour was great, and everything was perfectly timed in order to enjoy as much as possible. Our guide Jon made the experience more worthwhile and was really informative in a fun and enjoyable manner. Definitely recommend
