And the monastery is very beautiful, it's like a guardian watching the fields. We had a great time to a very old winery. Our guide, Pol, told us a short version history about Barcelona and Montserrat. He is a very good teller, in my opinion Pol is ment to be a guide.
It's a trip that i'll definatellly recommend!

Took part in the tour in August 2022 with Edu as my guide.

Had a wonderful time. Edu was a fantastic guide and led the trip excellently. The monastery and winery visits were a great value experience. Strongly recommended.

This excursion was the highlight of our 15-day, 5-country European tour. Our tour guide, Violeta, did an excellent job! The Montserrat area is amazing and should be included in everyone's vacation schedule. The history, the views, the cathedral, even the rigorous walk up to the cross were amazing. And, to top it all off, the tour finished at the winery where we enjoyed wine tasing and tapas. Being in a small group also enhanced the experience. We'll be back some day and will specifically request Violeta as our guide.

This was a fantastic tour and even better was our tour guide, Jennifer. Jennifer is a book of knowledge. She's also very kind and super helpful. She is happy to help and answer any questions, and she made the tour super fun! I highly recommend this tour for anyone visiting Barcelona!

Anays was wonderful and was very easy to understand and very energetic. We learned a lot everywhere we went and had a wonderful day! The scenery was beautiful and everything was very well organized. The wine was delicious and Anays knew so much about it and made the tasting experience very fun!

Had a wonderful day with our tour guide Gus touring Montserrat, wine tasting and lunch. Gus was great, quite knowledgeable, personable, funny, and made the day go by quickly. It was a great experience and recommend this tour-ask for Gus!!!

Anna was an amazing tour guide and the trip was well worth the day!
Montserrat and the winery were gorgeous, it was an awesome experience to leave the city and see some of the countryside.
We did the lunch option and wine tasting.
SUCH a great day!

What a great day in Spain!! Monserat was beautiful and the views amazing! I bought some goat cheese from a vendor.
We then went to a castle winery Oller del MAS and had an awesome lunch, tour, and wine tasting.
Our guide Lauren was awesome!! Very friendly and informative and knew her information on both Monserat and the family history on OLLER DEL MAS!

Great tour!!

Guides were good. Very crowded at site, but the guides made every effort to move around the crowds.
Would suggest that guides talk about particulars to prepare for site: such as additional line for Black Madonna, 2nd cogwheel train to top, hike to St Michael's, ect.

This trip is a must, it was amazing! Our guide, Marta was so knowledgeable and fun, we learned so much. I wouldn’t spend the time to walk to St Michael’s Cross, but I would spend the time in the Cathedral, which brought tears to my eyes, the shop and the little market place. Our next guide, Borja was great. He took us to the winery, and gave us a tour with a quick lesson and a wine tasting. This trip was worth every penny!

This tour was my favorite thing to do while visiting Barcelona on my honeymoon! Marta was a fun, knowledgeable, & energetic tour guide.We can be friends in real life! Montserrat has the most breathtaking views and so much history to take in. We had a great group that mingled well with each other and even went out with two other couples afterwards!! The vineyard and wine was GREAT!!! Be sure to pet the vineyard’s dog Vino and you must try the orange wine! If you’re thinking about booking this tour, JUST DO IT!

Fun day! Our guide, Marcel, was very friendly and knowledgeable. Monserrat was beautiful. Nice mix of guided tour and free time. The winery was lovely. Nice way to end the day. Would definitely recommend.

Our guide Anays made this a wonderful excusion. She was knowlegeable and personable and passionate about wine. We're so glad we did the add on tour to the winery for tapas and wine tasting as this part was really a highlight for our entire vacation. The tasting room was in a part of the old castle that provided an amazing ambience. afterwards we were able to enjoy another glass outside with views of Montserrat. just a lovely day.

The whole experience was brilliant! Our tour guide Francesc was entertaining and informative. Montserrat was beautiful, thoroughly recommend the cheese market! The winery and tapas lunch was delicious. We had a lovely day out!

Great tour! We did this last Tuesday.. Our guide was named Pol.. He really made the tour fun.. He was super personable and extremely informative. Also a cutie .. :) I came home with amazing photos and memories from this trip.. So happy I booked it..

We had a wonderful time- Montserrat was absolutely gorgeous as was the ride there and up the mountain. The tour guides were very informative about the region on the way. Lunch was delicious (and private away from other tourists unlike a lot of Barcelona), as was the wine tour. The wine was hands down the best I tried between Spain and Portugal. Our tour guide Jon was the best- passionate about his job, funny, and wonderful to chat with.

We booked this not knowing anything else to do while
in Barcelona and we are so glad we did. We had a great time and it was very interesting and beautiful. Even if you are not a religious person the trip to Montserrat Monastery was historically interesting and beautiful. Our tour guide Marta was amazing and made the trip so much more fun. Wine tasting was great with a delicious meal.

Wonderful day visiting Montserrat. Violetta our guide was super sweet and fun. She told the history in a light and interesting way. Spectacular views!!
Lunch was fine but it would have been nice to try more of the local cuisine.
Winery tour was interesting. We didn't need an hour after the tour to just sit around and have another glass of wine though. It would have been nicer to have that extra time in Montserrat.

Excellent tour...the visit to Montserrat was beautiful. We hiked out to the St. Michael's cross to get a fabulous view. Pep was our tour guide and we had a fabulous history lesson. The wine tasting was fun and the winery was beautiful!

A very nice and funny tour with a nice and very knowledgeable guide (Merak). Montserrat - a very impressive place, I recommend seeing the museum. Winetour - great wine and food, beautiful winery. Thanks Merak!

The entire trip was fabulous- the views and all the things we learned about the region on the way, the monestary itself, the winery ... all fantastic. Our tour guide, Pol, was so knowledgeable and friendly. You can tell that he is passionate about and loves what he does. We wondered if the trip would be worth the money but it was!

Kudos to JON!! He was very knowledgeable in all the points covered in this tour. We learned so much from Jon, and he is very funny as well. We had such a wonderful time, with enough time at Montserrat to explore on our own. Lunch was very nice and we had two different kinds of wine with the meals. The wine tasting portion of the tour was excellent. The portion of wine served was more than I expected. In all, I totally recommend this tour !! You would be very blessed to have JON as your guide.

Thank you so much for taking us on the Monastery and Winery tour. We had a wonderful experience with our guide Javi. The guides are very charming and well spoken, we were entertained throughout. I highly recommend this tour as it has something for everybody.

If you are a lover of food and wine, you will find the selection exquisite. Javi speaks about wine as a true aficionado and the tapas paired excellently.

For history buffs, this tour represents an opportunity to interact with centuries past. Roman history, medieval history, early modern and modern eras collide in these beautiful mountains.

For the adventurous, there are numerous opportunities to explore some of the most breathtaking vistas and get some exercise in with a hike along the side of the mountain.

Thanks again Javi, we couldn't be more pleased!

2 couples over 50! From Australia! What a lovely day! Comfortable bus ride, Montserrat is a wonderful experience. Nuria our guide was very friendly and knowledgeable. She made sure she knew each of the participants by name and ensured our experience was individualised. The tapas were yummy and the wine tasting enjoyable. I highly recommend this day trip. It was not expensive but the day was full of fun and activity

The whole day was so well organized. Both Victor and Nuria made the day so worthwhile. We got lots of history and so much consideration to ensure all our needs were met (any food allergies and preferences were highly considered). Nuria was so personable and spent the day like she was with friends. Highly recommend this tour. You won’t be disappointed!

This tour was wonderful on all accounts; tour guides Merak and Marcel were amazing. They had so much information to share and were fun and easy going. I suggest walking to the St. Michael Cross and enjoying time for the liqueur and cheese tasting.

Would recommend with a guide to learn about the history. Enjoyed wine and cheese tasting, cottage cheese and honey from local vendors. Views are stunning.
Wine and tapas at local winery was excellent.
We spent a lovely day in Montserrat! Gus was a wonderful guide. The day ended with a visit to a lovely little winery. We enjoyed it so much we left with several bottles. Definitely recommend!

Tour was excellent. Dani was our tour guide and provided great information. He was knowledgeable on history of all the sights at Monserrat. Make sure to choose the lunch over the tapas. The lunch was amazing. Delicious soup, tender duck breast, and yummy dessert. Dani told us about the winery and the tour ended with a lovely wine tasting.

Our Montserrat tour was amazing... our tour group had a great time, Ana our tour guide was the best. We would take a tour with her anytime. Montserrat has so much history. Take the train up to the top and hike around.

This tour was amazing! It was our favorite tour that we did. Marcel our guide was excellent and was so funny and informative. Going up to the Monastery was awesome and the wine tasting after was great. Would highly recommend this tour! If you could go to one place outside Barcelona, this should be to!

The tour was absolutely amazing, really informative and fun. We saw some really incredible views, learnt a lot about the history of the place and enjoyed a nice lunch with some local wine tasting. Pol was a really friendly and entertaining guide :)

This was truly a highlight of our trip to Barcelona. Sergio, our guide, was knowledgeable, friendly and extremely fun to spend the day with. The views from Montserrat were breathtaking. The tapas was quite good and the wine tasting at Oller del Mas Winery was both an educational and tasty experience. This tour is a MUST INCLUDE for anyone visiting Barcelona!

We had the most incredible day with our awesome guide Toni! It was such a gorgeous day up to Montserrat and Toni was super helpful with explaining all the things we could do on our free time. He shared great knowledge of the site we visited as well as for the area and of Catalunya. On our free time we took his suggestion of the hike to the cross which was gorgeous, used the coupons for liquor tasting and enjoyed the cheeses of the farmer's market! Then when we got to the winery we had a fun and lighthearted time learning about the history of the winery, the family, and the castle. We drank great wine and ate great tapas and overall we just had a fantastic day! We will highly recommend this tour to family and friends!

When we arrived to Barcelona I was interested in doing a wine tour. The hotel we stayed at recommended this company and I am so happy they did!! The tour was educational and had wonderful staff who were all so friendly and nice! The tour was 6.5 hours and I thought it was the perfect amount of time to see the monastery and winery! If you are staying in Barcelona for a few days I would definitely do this tour!!! The views of the mountain are breath taking!!! This is a very nice tour company as well! Our tour guide names Agnes was amazing!! She really made everyone feel welcome on the tour! So friendly and nice :) this tour was worth every penny and our time! I would 100% take it again!!

Six of us participated in the Montserrat, wine, and tapas tour from Barcelona. Our guide, Luis, was absolutely phenomenal! He was very knowledgeable, fun and funny, and did just the right blend of providing interesting information and allowing time to simply take in the sites. The tour began on a new, well-appointed coach and then we took a beautiful tram ride up to Montserrat. After a short tour of the grounds and information on what we might want to do during our 1-1 1/2 hour exploration time, four in our party walked to the cross on the hill upon Luis' recommendation. We are so glad we did. Beautiful views and a nice walk (paved trail though of course steep in places). There is a lot to explore at Montserrat and it's history is intriguing and interesting! The tour provided vouchers to try the specialty liquors made there and bread or cookies were provided with the tasting as well. After Montserrat we procedded to the winery. We enjoyed tasting the excellent wines and I liked that it was an organic winery. Again, Luis was very informative. Gathering with our party of 14 around a large table to enjoy tapas and wine was fun. The day flew by and we had a memorable experience that we will long cherish.

We were met promptly at 8:30 and on our way by 8:45. The bus was very comfortable and clean
We had very good tour guides Xavi and Louis and a professional bus driver.
We explored Monserrat and farmers market in the morning followed by a tour of Oller del Mas winery with tapas and wine tasting.
At Montserrat their was an hour long line to walk past the Black Madonna. As we only had 45 minutes we were encouraged to see it from afar during services. It felt disrespectful to be taking photos during religious services but maybe that’s just me.
If you are going specifically to see the black Madonna this may not be the tour for you. We took a brisk walk uphill about 20 min and got beautiful views.
The winery tour was pretty good. But the tasting consisted of three small tasting glasses of three different wines. Again if you’re really focused on tasting a variety of wine, may not be for you.
But overall pretty good. Best part was our guides.

This was a birthday treat, Alex was our guide. He's so knowledgeable & passionate about wines; Spanish food & culture. Friendly & humorous, giving us loads of tips of where to eat & visit. He certainly made the trip fun & very enjoyable. The Cogwheel train to Montserrat allows you to take some great foto shots up the mountains. The Montserrat tour was well explained allowing us time to try the local sweet pastry-"coca de Montserrat"; local liquors; as well as visit the Abbey & have time to taste the different cheeses from the farmers market(fresh & cheaper than the shops). The coach took us to Oller del Mas vineyard, where the tour around the winery showed us the original brick storage vats of the past to current french oak barrels. A private reception to taste tapas & 4 different wines. Thank you Alex for making my birthday special & introducing me to the l'Olive restaurant ! Next time I will bring my grown children to try this fantastic experience!

This was a great trip to a beautiful town just outside of Barcelona. The tour was very well organized and packed a lot into one day. Monserrat was stunning (definitely do the short hike out to the cross for amazing views) and the small farmer’s market was such a gem. The liquor tasting was a fun added touch (though I wasn’t a huge fan...) and the coca (sweet break thing) was yum.

The vineyard was beautiful. Wines were tasty and tapas were nice. We chose the tapas version (vs lunch) which I think saved us 2 hours. If you aren’t stretched for time, the food would probably be better at the lunch, but overall I was happier with our itinerary (we were a smaller group).

Borja was a great tour guide - he was super knowledgeable, funny and gave great recommendations throughout. Would recommend this highly to anyone looking for a fun day trip during a stay in Barcelona.

Omg what an amazing tour! We can’t stop talking about how awesome this tour was. Our guide (Jordi) was super funny, knowledge, and knew everyone’s names.
We’ve been traveling together as friends for 3 years across Europe now and he is our favorite guide we’ve ever had.
We crossed paths with a couple from that your today and we couldn’t stop talking about how he’s spoiled us for all other tour guides.

My husband and I took this tour during our recent visit to Barcelona. It was nice to get out of the city limits for the day and enjoy the breathtaking views atop Montserrat. Lorenzo was an exceptional tour guide and clearly has a passion for his work. We visited the beautiful cathedral on top of the mountain and then proceeded to a 1000 year old castle for a wine tasting and tapas. It was a really fun day, and I enjoyed meeting people from all around the world in my tour group.

My wife and I chose the lunch option for this tour. The distance out of the city was not bad at all so not much time is wasted by driving time. We had plenty of time to ourselves at the monetary and the lunch was very good.

I received excellent customer service from this company before the trip began, due to a date mix up. The tour itself was great - the bus ride was entertaining with some Barcelona history (told in a humerus way), and the first stop at Montserrat was great - Carol was fantastic. We had ample time to do everything we wanted to do (walk to the cross, visit the market, try the liquor).

The wine tasting was great too :)

10/10 would recommend!
Recommend this tour for seeing Montserrat and wine tasting—and learning a bit of Barcelona history along the way. All of the guides were very knowledgeable and entertaining, but especially Mercedes.

My family and I were in Barcelona for 7 days and wanted to visit Montserrat. Looking through TripAdvisor, I saw all the great reviews for this company. Thank God I found them because we had an awesome day trip!

My husband and 2 sons (ages 14 and 10) decided to the Montserrat and Tapas Tour with the Cogwheel Train up to Montserrat. The tour was pretty much the whole day. We met with the group at 9:45am on a Sunday and promptly left at 10am. We had Toni as our tour guide, but also shared the bus with Xavi. Xavi kept us entertained throughout the whole bus ride (both going and coming back). He also provided a great history lesson of Barcelona.

Once we got to Montserrat, we all boarded the cogwheel train. It was great watching the scenery of the mountain as we rode along. When we arrived to the top, Toni gave us a tour of the monastery and then we had an hour of free time. My advice...an hour is not enough. We barely had time to visit the cathedral and the farmer's market. We didn't even get a chance to visit St. Michael's cross. Also, the line was so long to see the Black Madonna. If I could do this tour again, I would make sure to book the one that gives you the most time at the monastery.

Afterwards, we boarded the bus again and headed to Oller de Mas. This is one of the oldest wineries in Catalonia. Toni was great at giving us a tour and explaining the wine making process. We only booked tapas because some reviews said that lunch wasn't that great. The tapas were more than I thought we would get. We got a welcome glass of white wine with cheese and crackers. Then we had a sample of 3 more wines with a meat and cheese board, potato salad, pan con tomate, olives and Spanish cheesecake. It was a lot of food. The wines were incredible and so affordable if you choose to buy them. Toni was great at teaching us about the different notes and flavors of the wine, and how the wine was produced. Toni hasn't been with the company for long, but you can tell he is really knowledgable and passionate about his job.

If we return, I would definitely book again with this company. They were awesome!

Tip: Bring your own bottle of water. They don't provide any until you sit down to eat.

Excellent tour would highly recommend you see Montserrat. The cogwheel train was a great experience and the views were spectacular. The wine and tapas tour was a great way to experience Spanish wine. Although you are in a large group on the bus in the beginning, you are broken up into smaller groups for the actual tour which makes it more of a private tour feeling.

This trip was worth every penny. Our tour guide Toni was attentive, professional and knowledgeable. The bus ride was on time and comfortable. Cog wheel train ride up the mountain made the trip more interesting. Monastery was beautiful and so heavenly especially when the boys choir sang. surrounding area was a great sight to see. Wine tasting and tapas meal were also very good and filling. All in all, it was a great tour! Highly recommend to others.

We took a group of 10 university students and 3 coordinators for the tour of Monserrat and the tapas and wine tasting tour of Ca’Nestella Winery.

Our tour guide Ana was incredible, the best we had on our entire trip. She was knowledgeable and able to adjust her style to fit everyone’s needs! The students said this was the best thing we did our whole trip in Barcelona!

Monserrat is beautiful and arriving at the top in the cogwheel train provides incredible views. The winery was a great space and the tapas were enough for lunch and the wine delicious. More unexpectedly they also make olive oil which was loved by all. We all brought a bottle home!

Thank you Castlewine tours and Ana!

MONTSERRAT WAS SO BEAUTIFUL! Our tour guide, Toni, was excellent!!! He gave us some interesting history of Barcelona and Montserrat that we weren't expecting but honestly made our entire trip so much more enjoyable. He was knowledgable about all aspects of the tour but still was able to have fun and joke around with the group. We can't praise him enough for his hard work and superb customer service. Wine and tapas were so delicious! The wine is so different from what we've ever experienced in the states, it was truly a unique experience and highly recommended as a way to get out of the city for the day. We did the half day tour and it was the perfect amount of time.

Tips: If visiting Montserrat in the winter - bring clothing items for cold and windy weather! Don't forget to get cash out BEFORE the tour. Bring water. If you decide to hike up to the cross (La Creu) at Montserrat, it is about a 20-minute hike UPHILL and quite strenuous.

Our half-day tour of the monastery at Montserrat and the Oller del Mas Winery housed in a 10 century castle was one of the highlights of our week long stay in Barcelona. Our tour guide, Albert, was the perfect host, gave us a thorough history of the city of Barcelona, the Monastery, and shared his extensive knowledge of wines at our wine tasting. We arrived in the midst of the autumn festival and had a simply marvelous time. Albert even took time to answer a host of questions about where to dine in Barcelona from his prior experience as a concierge. He's easily one of the best guides we've encountered in our trips around the world.

We went on the tour with the wine tasting and had the best time! Ana was super knowledgeable about everything in Montserrat and was incredibly helpful. She was kind and also made the trip really fun. We would highly recommend going and requesting Ana!

I took this tour with my mother while we were visiting Barcelona. We thought that the tour, and Jordi, were both excellent! Although we were a bit nervous about being herded on to a bus with the larger group, it was handled very well and it felt very organized. We were assured that we would be in the larger group only for transportation and that was the case. Jordi’s brief overview of the history of Barcelona was fantastic and he handled a somewhat unruly group at the back of the bus like a true professional! We enjoyed breaking off into smaller groups and being able to interact with and clearly hear Jordi once we arrived at each location. He was very sensitive to the varying needs of everyone in the group and never rushed anyone along. The tour itself felt like just the right amount of information, as well as free time to explore! We would both happily take this tour again.

Montserrat made me fall in love with Barcelona. Thanks to our amazing tour guide Danny we were able to learn the most about Montserrat and why its so beautiful! I recommend doing the hike when he gives you free time. The views are exceptional. The wine and tapas tour did not disappoint. Danny taught us how to smell and analyze the wine and what foods to combine them with. My boyfriend and I used these tips for the rest of our trip in Barcelona. Thank you Danny!

A really nice trip to Montserrat and wineyard. Well organised and Clara, our guide was a very good guide,knowlegdeable both in history and winemaking. We recommend this trip for adults, not very suitable for kids.

In my second visit to Barcelona, I wanted to try something I hadnt the first time around. This tour was recommended to me, and I honestly could not be happier that I decided to give it a try. It was the highlight of my trip. It was peaceful, serene, and just overall jaw dropping.

Sandra, our tour guide was incredible. She was so sweet and knowledgeable. My mom has some mobility issues, and Sandra was so patient and encouraging. She ensured that we both were able to participate in each activity and fully experience all the trip had to offer, so major thank you to her!

We were a group of 7 Americans who ended up on a tour with a family of Australians and Brits. What a fun day we had! Our tour guide, Marta, made an effort to learn many of our names and interacted beautifully with the small children in the group and with our group of retirees. Her explanations and small lessons were informative and interesting, and she kept us engaged the whole day. The ride to Montserrat is stunning, and the amount if free time we had was just right. The wine tasting and lunch were delicious. Our group was so happy that our hotel recommended Castle Experience, and we were lucky to have been paired with Marta.

Our guide was fantastic, he told us a history of Barcelona during our bus ride (albeit a tragic one - they were always on the loosing side). Do the lunch and wine tasting option, you will not be sorry.
David and Jordi were great tour guides. I thought the time at Montserrat was a little too long but it was nice to see.

Despite the rain, I had a great time on this tour. We left a little late, but the bus was comfortable and the train was nice as well. Would have been nice to have an addition hour ( or at least a half ). Seemed a long trip for a short amount of actual visitation. While the tapas and wine tasting was of good quality, I could have done without the tour of the processing area - again, would have preferred to spend that time up at Monserrat

This was a wonderful trip and Mercedes was a great tour guide. We learned all about Catalonia's history and the trip was great. Montserrat is magnificent and the wine tasting very informative. Especially liked the introduction to Vermut as an aperitif. The only disappointment was not being able to stay for the whole boys choir performance. I found out later we needed to book the longer lunch tour if we wanted to stay for the whole performance. I cannot say enough good about the tour guides and the tour itself I highly recommend it.

This was such a great experience! Everything from start to finish was smooth and our guide, Rubi, was so kind and knowledgeable. At the monastery, we had a mini guided tour and then about 45 min of free time to wander. It’s not too big up there so we just took some photos, walked through the basilica, and sampled the farmers market.

We chose the 3 course meal and the food was delicious. The wine tastings were fantastic and the winery was beautiful. Tip: don’t sit in the back of the bus from Montserrat to the winery. It’s a windy road, I got a little car sick!

Tour group was prepared in morning - well organized however the time inside Montserrat was completely inadequate. The wine tasting aspect was weighted more heavily- unnecessarily. The museum was fantastic and the basilica spectacular! Hearing the boys choir was a bonus! Tour should have started earlier in morning.
Was not happy with return from mountain- bus driver took fast turns - would have preferred train.
The leader of our tour - Mercedes - was brilliant- shared a vast knowledge with a quick smile. Expressed real concern for all members of the group. Dietary needs were carefully honored.

I went for the trip with the later start and lunch option. Easy to find the tour. The bus trip out was fine. Great comments from the tour guides about the history of Barcelona. I didn't mind being with the other groups on the bus there and back. My group had 7 of us in, and for the Montserrat tour was just us. Our guide Luis was great. Good knowledge and easy to talk to. We did combine with another group from the earlier tour as one of the guides had to leave which meant a slightly bigger group for lunch and wine tasting, but this wasn't a problem and good to meet some new faces. Not a huge amount of free time at Monserrat, but I knew this when booking the tour (picked extra sleep over extra free time). Just enough time to walk up to the cross on the hill (which is quite a challenging uphill walk) and look at the markets. If you want to do more than this then pick the trip with the earlier start.

My husband and I really enjoyed this tour, especially Montserrat.
Had we known it was so great we would have spent a total day there!
Max was very knowledgeable and together with Rubi and Dani they made a great trio
THe wine in Catalunya is fairly young, so for this reason I will only give 4 stars
But it was a fabulous day, very well organized, and the tapas were great
Awesome day out with an amazing Tour Guide Laura.She was very knowledgeable and all made it a lot of fun.Great wine and great tapas.

We took the excursion with Anna. She was terrific. Lots of energy and knowledgeable. She made the trip worthwhile. The visit at Montserret was very good but it would have been nice to have more time to explore. The tapas and wine tasting left something to be desired. The tapas and wine were served in a room too big and the tapas were nothing special. The wines tasting was good. I would suggest choosing another vineyard where you can visit the wine making as well as the vineyard. Anna made it better than it was. Thanks Anna.

My partner and I thoroughly enjoyed our tour to Montserrat and local winery. Our tour guide, Alex, was very knowledgeable, patient and friendly, ensuring everyone was enjoying their day. Montserrat was such a unique destination surrounded by amazing scenery. Our visit to an ancient winery, including a delicious tapas lunch with wine, was a delightful way to finish our day. I would definitely recommend!

Lovely day trip. The train journey up the mountain was spectacular. Montserrat was beautiful, even had time to hear a couple of songs by the choir. The drive down the mountain provided a different, equally spectacular view. The wines were lovely and the tapas tasty. Our guide was great.

My daughter and enjoyed this day tour. Sylvia, our guide was knowledgeable about Barcelona and the history of Montserrat. She was engaging, friendly and shared many stories with us. We had plenty of time to visit the church, and surrounding area. The second half of the tour at the winery was pleasant. The wine was good but the tapas were basic cheese and ham with a side salad.

Usually I don't like to book tours because I prefer to take my time getting to know a location and not be constrained by a strict schedule. However the way to get to Montserrat whether by public transit or by driving is very inconvenient, also I can honestly say if I didn't have wonderful Mr. Xavi as a tour guide I would have fallen into so many tourist blunders.

The tourbus ride to the mountain base was comfortable and quick. We were then unloaded for a bathroom break and then loaded into a tram to go up the mountain. A quick tour was done with Mr. Xavi where we learned about the history of Montserrat and got a complimentary wine tasting with Xavi at the shop there. A farmers market is also going on if one were to want to purchase goods.Free time was given for one here where xavi suggested things that we could do independently. After meeting up again we were taken to our tapas and wine tasting. Do not worry about being left hungry because you definitely will not be!

Book this tour and choose Xavi! Also on a side note he is quite cute. =)

We had a great time on this excursion with our tour guide Xavi. An air conditioned bus took us on a 50 minute ride up to the mountains of Montserrat. During this ride we got a little information about Spain from one of the tour guides. Once we departed the bus we took a 10 minute funicular ride up the hillside to the Monastery. We had a tour around the grounds and then went in to see the inside of the Monastery. The Monastery is very beautiful with many chandeliers hanging all around the church. Our tour guide gave us the background about them but I will save that info to myself so it will be new to you. My only disappointment was, I thought we were going to see the Black Madonna but it was from a distance we saw it. Makes sense because of how the line proceeds it would be hard for tours to cut in line and the line is about 3 hours long. After the tour of the church we had about an hour of free time. We did a local liqueur tasting and then browsed the local farmers market and tasted local cheeses and nuts, yummy. After this we were then bussed to Oller Winery where again we had a tour of the inside of the castle. Xavi our tour guide was also our wine expert. We tasted 2 whites and 2 reds. Xavi taught our group how to properly taste wine. I'm a red wine drinker but I actually enjoyed the whites more, I think the reds were just too young and with a little age would be amazing. I wished I would have purchased some wine but we were traveling with carry-ons and that would not work with bottles of wine. We were also served some amazing Tapa's. This was exactly what I was looking forward to, the Spanish Tapa's. They were amazing and very authentic. I thoroughly enjoyed this tour and I am so happy I left the city to enjoy another area of Spain. Our guide Xavi was a lot of fun, very energetic and great to be around. He truly made this trip fun. Thank you Xavi.

We absolutely loved the Monserrat Monastery and Oller del Mas Winery tours. We ended up on the cogwheel train which was a huge plus as it offered amazing views on the way up the mountain. We opted for the tapas option which was more delicious and a more intimate setting than the full lunch. The food and wine were wonderful, but Marta 100% made the experience for us! She was extremely knowledgeable, friendly, funny and accommodating to my allergies. The tour overall was timed very well and we will be highly recommending to friends and family traveling here in the future.Laura also added some wonderful insight as well and made a great team with Marta.
Thanks to Maria, a very memorable trip to Montserrat followed by a wine tour. The wine and tapas were excellent.
We had a wonderful time with Alex as our guide. He is very knowledgeable about Montserrat and especially about the wines and cheeses that we tasted. We enjoyed the whole tour.

My wife and I took this tour in mid May in the middle of a one week visit to Barcelona. It proved to be an exceptional experience! Marta was an outstanding guide and our travel companions became almost like an extended family. The monastery experience was quite magical, and we found the museum to be a real jewel (small but first rate collection) which we largely had to ourselves. And the winery proved a wonderful conclusion to the tour. Highly recommend.

Ci-dessous, mon commentaire transmis à l'organisation suite à leur demande. A noter, excellente communication tout au long du processus mais, avoir su, j'aurais été les voir directement avant de réserver sur lecture simplement du feuillet. Néanmoins, une belle journée et Merak est une perle !!

hello, as requested, here are some comments on our day "Monserrat, wine, tapas" that we did with the guide Merak. Overall, a good day. Merak is easy to access and a good contagious mood. Excellent explanations and great availability all day. The tapas room was beautiful and the tapas was well presented and varied. The 3 wines were well chosen.

In short: 8/10. Adequate price for the service

What we liked less :

- 70 min total available in Monserrat. Too little ... especially 10 min to the Basilica, it's really short. We would have liked to have 2 hours at least

- Would have liked to meet the owners of the winery. Hear them tell us about their lives, their passion. Otherwise, it's a visit a bit cold, impersonal

- Give us a little space !!! No need to be stuck on each other or to be counted every 15 minutes!

Et leur réponse (en plein milieu de la nuit, pour eux !)

We really appreciate your honest feedback, since it helps us get better day after day. It seems like you might have enjoyed our Full Day Tour better, since it provides a bit more than two hours of free time in Montserrat. Sometimes it’s hard to know which tour we’re going enjoy the most in advance, and we apologize if we didn’t make your options clear enough. Regarding your comment about the winery, you might have noticed that Oller del Mas is a small cellar with a few workers, so sometimes is hard to find someone there the greet us. All of our guides have been personally trained by both the enologist and the sommelier from the property and they are considered the winery’s ambassadors.

My boyfriend and I have been visiting Barcelona in May 2019 for the first time. Our tour to Montserrat, that also included winery and tapas after the monastery was a highlight of the whole trip. We loved our tour guide Agnès. She had great sense of humor, very knowledgeable... and just a pleasant person to be around. We enjoyed her story about the monastery, then she conducted a wine tasting event all by herself; talking about winemaking business in the region; was very interesting.
We were outside of Barcelona , but we had a great time. Majestic place and beautiful people ! I feel coming back to see Montserrat again.

We had a great tour with Marta. We had more free time at Montserrat that we expected, which was great! The winery location is beautiful and the tasting was educational and delicious. Having a vegan diet, they did a great job of providing us a wonderful cold tapas lunch.

We really enjoyed the whole trip and especially the wine tour, as my sister Anto is really into that. Moreover, Pep, our Tour guide has been great and very friendly with us all. He was always willing to answer our question and very clear at explaining everything we saw. He was doing the tour both in English and in Spanish to make everyone feel more comfortable and understand better. Nothing bad to say! I would definitely recommend it to my friends! :)

Alessandra & Antonietta

We visited Montserrat with Pep who really made the tour much more educational and interesting. It is obvious he loves his job and he was so well informed of Catalan history and was able to explain all about the winery as well.
Montserrat was beautiful and we could have easily have spent the day there. There were several options from walking up to the cross at St Michael for an even better view, or visiting the art gallery, shopping, seeing Madonna and child, or just walking all over the grounds. All options were beautiful. After Montserrat, we drove over to the winery where Pep started us with a delicious welcoming wine and then we learned about the types of wine they make and about the history of the winery and of Spanish wines. We had a delicious tapas lunch followed with a few more wines where Pep introduced each wine and served us our food. The ride back was sprinkled in with various historical information but not too much with enough time to rest from the day.
I highly recommend this trip thanks to Pep who made it awesome!

The trip to Montserrat and the Castle for tapas and wine was a wonderful experience. Our guide, Toni made us feel welcome and entertained. He was so warm and friendly and had lots to share throughout the tour. On Montserrat, we were given a tour and provided time to experience some of the mountain on our own time, which I really enjoyed and then the wine and tapas were so neat. The castle was really interesting and all of the wine was delicious. Thanks Toni and team for a great trip!
If you are in Barcelona you should visit Montserrat. I'm not a big fan of group tours, but this was really nice, easy & professionally run. Our tour guide, Pep, was very knowledgeable & friendly.

Aurora was very knowledgeable, helpful and fun. The arrangements were easy to make, well organize considering the initial number of people congregating in one place to be separated for the type of tour. One of the few tours that offfered a nice time to start aka 10 am, not 8am as for other similar tours. It was nice the combination with the special train. The lliqor testing with a pastrie at the monetary and the wine testing were very pleasant and the castle and wine making description interesting.

The tour was a small group, taking a bus to Montserrat, riding the cog-wheel up to the monastery, followed by a wine tasting and tapas lunch. Our tour guide was Pol and during the drive to the monastery he explained the history of Catalunya, the history of Montserrat and about the countryside we were driving through. On arrival at the parking area we were fortunate to get on the cog wheel right away, allowing us some more time at the monastery. Pol showed us round, explaining what we were seeing and what to look for. The weather was beautiful and sunny and the views spectacular. There is plenty to see and several trails you can take. We then took the bus to the Ollers vineyard, where Pol did an excellent job of explaining the process of the wine making. This was followed by the wine tasting and tapas and again Pol showed his knowledge and passion for the wine and food. Although the tour was about 7-7.1/2 hrs it passed very quickly. Would definitely recommend this tour and would like to thank Pol again for making it a memorable day.

My brother and I had a great time on this excursion with Pep, despite the weather being much colder than expected. Pep provided some helpful information on the history of Spain, and Barcelona in particular, on our drive out to Montserrat, and, as we got closer to the monastery, described the origins of the monastery and the Black Madonna. The small size of our tour group made the tapas portion especially enjoyable, and it was fun to learn more about the different types of wines produced at the winery.
Great tour with Jordi, a knowledgeable guide with a great sense of humour. A good balance of activities and options for a half day tour.

Absolutely fabulous
Albert and the team where organised full of information and lots of fun
The Montserrat tour was excellent and so was the visit to the winery with delicious wines to sample and excellent tapas
.Certainly a fantastic tour to do.

This tour was the highlight of our trip to Barcelona. Our guide, Alex, was friendly and knowledgeable. Montserrat is breathtaking and the wine tasting at a centuries-old castle/winery was a once in a lifetime experience.

Excellent full day tour from Barcelona. Communications were excellent from beginning to end. We rode to Montserrat in a large bus that was comfortable and Pol gave us an excellent and informative history of the Catalan region. After reaching the Monastery, we divided into two smaller groups (lunch and tapas). The group was the right size to stay together and listen to Pol tell us about the history and then get transported to the Winery to enjoy more information about the region, wine production, and Oller del Mas Cellar. Thank you Pol for a very enjoyable, informative, and special day.
Despite the rain we had a brilliant time with Xavi and Danni who were fun, charming and very knowledgeable. The tour is well worth the price with lots to see and do.

My friend and I decided to book this tour because it seemed the most well-rounded option out of all of the Monserrat/Wine tour options. Our guide Marta was welcoming from the start, and was very informative throughout the entire day. She was funny, went above and beyond, and made the day one that I will never forget. I am not usually a person to buy tours, but I am so glad that I did this time. Marta made sure that we were able to get the most out of our day, and we are so thankful to have gotten the opportunity to meet her. I would absolutely recommend this tour to anyone considering it.

This day trip to Montserrat ( stunning place) and then the winery was one of the highlights of my time in Barcelona. The tour guide Marta was excellent ( She was the best tour guide i have met, so far.), she was genuinely funny and made the whole trip enjoyable and took very good care of everyone in our small group. Only negative i would say is that we don’t get a lot of time to explore Monserrat, may be the tour could start an hour earlier to help with this. Overall i enjoyed every moment of this tour and would recommend it to anyone going on a Barcelona holiday. Thanks again Marta.

I had been there with my boyfriend in my birthday. We first met Monserrat, an amazing and different mountain where you can find our lady of Montserrat and her church. There you can also do some
Hiking, but the time is too tight to do this, so you can just visit the church and walk around the place.
The view is amazing and magical.
After you go to the winery where they produce organic wine, and we learn about the process of production and we have a tasting of wine and tapas afterwards. Everything is very well explained, and they were very careful with us. And the guide Ana gave me a cupcake with a candle to celebrate my birthday. Everything was perfect, including the quality of the bus. I highly recommend this tour for everyone.

A solid day trip. Our tour guide Marta was great - she was knowledgeable, funny, and totally enhanced our visit. The views from Montserrat were beautiful. We probably could have used another 30-45min there. The winery afterward was amazing. A very cool castle vineyard and the wines were quite good (we bought a couple bottles!). There were probably about 50 or so people on the tour. They separate you into smaller groups of about 14. Overall, we had a great time, but I can't say that it was exceptional (hence, the four stars).
Our experience at Montserrat and the wine tasting was spectacular. From the beautiful scenery, great wine and fantastic guide such as David, a great time was had by all.
What a great experience! Our guide Rubio was knowledgeable and fun! So glad we got to hear the boys choir in the basilica. Inspiring. The wine tasting was fun as was shopping at the gift store

It is 4 time i come to barcelona and it first time i go to this trip . Really nice trip and company
I would to thank ONA for nice day

Very enjoyable day. Guides used travel time to provide history of region and scenery was great. Time spent with Max at monastery was informative and well-paced. Winery story was interesting and wine talk was informative although wines and tapas were ordinary. All in all, well worth fee and time. Helped that day was sunny and temperatures were moderate.

My daughter (25) and I thoroughly enjoyed this tour. Our young, new guide, Ona, was friendly, knowledgeable and personable as were the other guides we met on the tour. The group size (11) meant that we had a very personal experience. The beauty of the countryside and views from the monastery are breathtaking. We enjoyed learning the history of the monastery and meeting the local farmers at the market stalls, as well as the many tasters we were offered. We were thrilled to be taken to a small, organic vineyard where we had, again, a very personal wine tasting experience with the lovely Ona. The wines were delicious as was the special vegan tapas, prepared especially for me. I would highly recomnend this tour.

This was bar far the most amazing experience in Barcelona! Everything was great : the tour guide Toni ( very friendly and knowledgeable). The comfortable bus ride , and of course the Monserrat!!! What an experience! I loved every minute of it , as well as free time spent there . And , of course , the wine tasting : yummy! Highly recommend!

Thank you very much to Ona who did a great job as our tour guide. Very well spoken and has the way to share her joy of life. I definitely recommend this tour.
Thank you

We had Aurora as our guide and she was so knowledgeable and so fun too. We loved the cogwheel train, loved the 'free time' to explore the trails surrounding the monastery on our own, and loved the drive in the bus to the winery. This was a perfect day to see a different side of the Catalonia region other than the busy city center. Thank you Aurora!

We had a fantastic time on this tour with Sergio. He was so fun and friendly and we learned a lot about Montserrat, the black Madonna, Catalonia, and wine tasting. The dinner and wine were both excellent, and we met a lot of interesting people. I highly recommend this tour. It was a highlight of our trip!

Had a really great time with Merak, he was informative and fun to be around! Driving along the mountain was treat for anyone who didn’t take a siesta-the views were beautiful! Montserrat was BEAUTIFUL and the pictures just don’t do it justice. The winery was lovely and we even got to eat grapes right off the vine! Can’t get much better than that! I would recommend this tour/company/Guide to anyone who wants a relaxed and fun experience!
Guides for charming & informative. A day of history, beauty, great wind & company...wear sneakers or foot wear for rugged walkway up the mountain for the view by the cross.
Our guide Max was exceptional. This day trip was absolutely worth it! If you are looking to explore outside of Barcelona City Center, but are not sure what to do, look no further.

This tour was really well done and our guide Ana was a amazing! The views were worth it alone and the history of the church and Monks was even cooler. We had the chance to hear the boys choir sing and would recommend that as one of the options to stay for. The winery and tasting was amazing and we learned some things about wine we didn’t already know. The only thing I would change is the buses and rooms were a little warm at times. Overall, totally worth the time this tour takes!
Fascinating train ride up to Montserrat Breathing views of the Valleys and Mesas. Lots of trails to explore and more panoramas.
A must see! Great history tour with a bit of wine(we were very happy) and great lunch option. The tour guide we had was amazing and we really enjoyed the experience.

What an amazing experience! I had booked it since my boyfriend would enjoy the winery tour. We had Marta as our guide and she was informative, outgoing and made the tour even more enjoyable. Upon our return to the hotel, we encouraged another couple to do the same!!

I highly recommend the tour!
You get to explore Montserrat with a friendly and knowledgeable guide, our was Toni and he was super great! The wine and tapas were also delicious, we saw amazing views along the way

We thoroughly enjoyed this trip. All the guides were friendly, knowledgeable, and accommodating.

Monserrat is amazing. The only critique is that I would have liked to have started an hour earlier in the day to have additional time there.

The wine tasting was fun and very enjoyable. Our guide for the day was Toni, when he told us he would be pouring the wine and guiding us through the tasting, I was skeptical.

I turns out that Toni is very knowledgeable about the wines of the region and very capable of answering any questions.

Rubi and Marta were also guides on this tour. Both were great.

We had a great time and would highly recommend this tour.

Laura was our guide and she was awesome! Had a great group of people on our tour. very fun. Wish we had more time to explore Montserrat but was a great introduction to this site! Wine tasting and tapas was also very fun. Book hhis- youwill not be disappointed!
This tour combined two fascinating elements with Montserrat and its mountain-top monastery filling the morning and a vineyard with wine tasting and tapas to complete the treat. Wonderful day out.

This was our first time in Barcelona and I can tell you that this tour to Montserrat was the highlight of our trip. Our tour guide Agnes was EXTRAORDINARY!!!!!! Very charismatic and passionate about showing us this beautiful mountain and the culture of the Catalan people. We did the tapas and wine tour and loved it so much we even brought a few bottles back home with us . Also, the Crema Catalana is PERFECTION, you can get it at the town's market. There is so much history in this beautiful city that you can't help but completely disconnect yourself from reality. I would recommend this tour to anyone who wants to get away from the noise and the craziness of the city. This is a great time to take in the breathtaking views of this unique mountain and to really enjoy life while drinking some great local wine:). What else can one ask for?

Very nice and well organized day trip to Monserrat. The guides are very dedicated and speak perfect English. The Tapas and wine tasting was a very good finish for the tour. I can fully recommend this tour.

Just returned from a last minute mini break to Barcelona. As we were only visiting for a few days I booked to do some activities before we left and the Monserrat trip with wine tour and tapas looked like something we would really enjoy!! We were right!! So glad we did, it turned out to be the best day of our holiday!! Found the meeting place outside the Hard Rock Cafe very easily, it is a very central location. We were all divided into small groups, ours was fourteen people(all couples) it looked like we had been put into groups of similar people. The louder, larger groups were kept together too!! Our group were from, England, America and Canada.(so all spoke English) our guide was called Rubi "big shout out to the Rubi group" Rubi was a big reason our tour was so great he was, young, enthusiastic and very knowledgeable about everything that we were shown. We drove by coach to the foot of the mountain, took a cogwheel train to the top. We took a tour of the monastery and cathedral and heard all about the history and the black Madonna, all very interesting. We tried a variety of liqueurs and a local pastry. We then had some free time to wander around at our leisure before meeting up to travel to the winery by coach. The views from the top of the mountain were amazing!! At the vineyard we had a tour and were told all about the history of the winery before a wine tasting and a light tapas lunch. It was all very informal(you definitely don't have to be a wine expert to enjoy this trip!) We then boarded the bus back to where we started. A fantastic day out, packed full of sun, culture and wine!!! definitely great value. Thank you Rubi you made our day out a great experience!!😀🍷☀️
Great day. Well organized and our guide Merak was fantastic. Pleasant, great sense of humour. Would highly recommend this particular tour and definitely Merak

This is a great tour. Our guide was new and he was amazing. They give you great tips of what to do in Montserrat for your hour if free time and 3 glasses of wine, amazing tapas, and a drink coupon to get tastings of local liqueurs in Montserrat (which wasn’t advertised but a great bonus). We also had the best cheese tasting ever (from the local market on the mountain) and I even ended up buying some. Truffle cheese and black pepper were the best! Couldn’t recommend this tour more!

Very organised tour. Our tour guide had a good sense of humour and gave tips about how to make the most of the tour.
The only issue I have is with the food given how much is charged for this tour the fact tapas was cold and the veggie option is a salad with some chickpeas is not really worth that much money.

We really enjoyed our trip to Montserrat and Oller del Mas! Agnes, our guide, was wonderful! She was very welcoming, knowledgeable, and entertaining. One of the other guides, Xavi (or "Mr. X" as he also went by) was also very friendly and entertaining. He told us some of the history of Catalonia, Barcelona, Montserrat and Manresa.
The trip itself was very nice. We started on an air conditioned coach and then took the Rack Railway to Montserrat. Montserrat is an amazing experience. Then it was off to the coaches to travel to Oller del Mas. Again, Agnes was a wonderful hostess. We enjoyed a delicious tapas while Agnes explained the wines that we were sampling.
I would book the trip again in a heartbeat. Thanks to Agnes, Xavi, and Castlexperience for a wonderful tour!

We went back and forth deciding to tour Montserrat by ourselves or doing the tour and we’re so glad we did the tour! We had a very small group of 7 led by Laura who is so sweet and endearing. She was very knowledgeable about the area and made sure that all members of the group could hear and were involved.

After we finished up at Montserrat, we took a really beautiful scenic ride to the winery and along the way a guide gave commentary on the sights around us.

We arrived at the winery and joined another small group with an equally charming tour guide, Marta. Both guides gave us information on the property before we got to enjoy tapas and the wine.

The tour was amazing because they also catered to our dietary restrictions! (My daughter and I are vegetarian while my son and husband are not). They were so thoughtful and had grape juice available for our kids (ages 12 & 10) to sip on while we tasted the wine. The wine and tapas were delicious and each item was introduced and explained. We were lucky and got to dine in a private room that felt very intimate. Our tour group felt like an instant family gathering!

They were incredibly thoughtful, very knowledgeable, and we would highly recommend this tour to anyone!

Wow! What an incredible day! Well worth the money and I recommend anyone in Barcelona take advantage of this! We did the half day tour to Montserrat and the wine and tapas tour. Our tour guide Sylvia was so wonderful! She was so kind, funny and SO knowledgeable! She made our day! Montserrat was absolutely breathtaking and probably our favorite part of our entire vacation. I recommend walking up to the cross at the top of the mountain. Stunning views! Then we drove down to the winery which was so fun! The castle was beautiful and we learned so much about the history of the winery and the wines. The tapas were delicious, as well! We do wish we got to taste a few more wines though. Overall an incredible day! Thanks Sylvia!
Great tour and good value good fun with our great tour guide for xavi 😎😎😎😎 well worth doing and great way to see Barcelona

This was an absolutely terrific tour! The scenery was beautiful and well worth the trip. The winery was on a beautiful piece of land and the tastings and tapas were wonderful. Best of all our tour guide Mercedes was awesome. She was very kind, fun and knowledgeable about each site! Thanks Mercedes for the perfect experience!!

We took this tour in Barcelona recently while visiting the city after a cruise ship arrival. Our guide Clara made this the best tour ever! She was personable and very knowledgeable, and her English was excellent. We had no problem understanding her, and we learned a lot about the monastery and area in general. The cogwheel train ride to the top of the mountain was fantastic. Amazing scenic views! The tapas and wine portion of the tour was great - generous portions and the wine flowed freely. We had the opportunity to purchase this unique winery's productions after the tour. Highly recommend this tour as the most convenient and best way to visit Montserrat while in Spain.

First of all, I really enjoyed the tour, it was totally worth it. Our group was very lucky to have Aina as our guide. She was friendly and attentive to everyone. I am a not native English speaker, so for me guide's speech was very important. Aina gave us a lot of information, her speech was not too fast, not too slow, easy to understand, so it was perfect for me. So, thank you Aina for a good and informative day!

And now about the tour in general. Monserrat is really beautiful place, but, at first, it was a little bit cold, so it's better to have a warm jacket and, of course, comfortable shoes. We had almost an hour of free time and it was enough to go around. Then we went to winery. I also enjoyed tapas lunch and wine tasting. But, in my opinion, it would be great if some local music played at low volume during the tapas lunch. I think it could create even more relaxing atmosphere. But, all in all, in was an excellent experience.

If you do one tour - you HAVE to do this one. What a thoroughly enjoyable day. Anna was our tour guide and she was a large part of the reason the day was so perfect. She is very knowledgeable but, most of all, she is so friendly, personable and what a cute sense of humor. The scenery is breathtaking and the tour allows free time to do your own thing at the monastery... bring a camera - it's beautiful. The wine tour was very informational and the tasting and tapas were great. Please do yourself gift and take this tour - hopefully, you'll get Anna but the other guides we met were also very nice. Well worth the money and time!

Our tour guide Marta, was excellent, she made us feel so comfortable, her knowledge was extensive and how she Told us was perfect, I would recommend Marta and her tours to anyone, we would use them again, no problem, Robert

My husband and I had originally planned to tackle a day trip to Montserrat on our own, but decided to go with this tour instead and overall I'm glad we did. Montserrat is 60-90 minutes out of the city and this made it stress free. In saying that, the train system when we arrived looked fairly straight forward and you do miss the gondola ride on the tour which looked cool. Tour guide Jordi was great, friendly, funny and laid back. You get a free hour at Montserrat after a quick tour--would recommend walking to the cross on the hill and sampling the local cheese. Would have been nice to have a bit more time. The addition of the winery stop was nice; not a picturesque castle but still cool. Tapas were a selection of cheese, bread and cured meats with 3 wines. You get a quick tour of the cellars and vines. Nice commentary on the bus ride there and home too.

My husband and I originally intended to drive or take the train up to Montserrat, but after our tours the day before around Barcelona we decided it was well worth the investment to to do the tour. It was a great decision!

Our tour guide was Aina and she was very knowledgeable about the area and the wines we tasted. She was very funny! We loved taking the tour with her and highly recommend it to anyone that wants a fun experience that has something for everyone: history, local wine, local food, a walk with a view, etc. Thank you, Aina!

I cannot express how much I enjoyed this tour. It was a fantastic concept to combine both a cultural visit with the food and wine tasting afterwards. It was a really enjoyable experience and the guides were fantastic and went above and beyond to ensure our every need was met. Even if you're not a wine connoisseur, this tour was still incredibly worth it and a lot of fun. It also makes the trio to Montserrat a lot more relaxed because all the details are taken care of. I would definitely recommend this tour company to anyone!

We booked this tour from the US some two months in advance of our trip to Barcelona on the basis of the positive reviews from Tripadvisor, and our previous positive experiences with Viator. Well worth it!

It was even better than we had imagined. Montserrat is majestic, and while we didn’t get alot of free time there, we were thoroughly immersed. Following Montserrat the setting of the Oller de Mas vineyards and castle is stunning, and we had a wonderful tapas lunch in an old stone room amongst the wine barrels. We tasted 4 wines overall, 2 whites 2 reds, each distinct and delicious. All of this bonded our tour group and made for great social time as well, even though we only knew each other for the duration of a day!

Thanks to the host castleexperience and especially our tourguide Pep for a magical day!

This tour made visiting Montserrat from Barcelona easy and fun! The tour was well organized and well run and informative. On the bus ride to Montserrat one of the tour guides talked to us about the history of Barcelona. Once there we broke up into smaller tour groups and had abotu an hour guided tour of Montserrat. Our tour guide Anges was so fun and great. We then had about 45 minutes of free time to explore and Anges gave us a couple recomendations on what to do. Then we headed to the winery where our guide gave a tour of the winery and then a guided wine tasting with tapas. Such a fun trip overall and I would definitely recommend!

It was worth any penny! When on vacation to a foreign place, sometimes it's worth letting someone else handle the arrangements and you just enjoy the day! Pol was our guide and we had a fantastic day trip. This was the most relaxed day we had during our trip and Pol was fantastic.
Everyone is entitled to opinions here but I'll say Montserrat is amazing and then when you are in a castle that dates back 1100 years, I suggest you take a deep breath, sip some wine and enjoy the fact you are fortunate enough to be there. Well worth the money and time spent. Will do again when in town.

Our flight to Iceland was delayed so we called Oriol the day before our tour and he was able to design a private tour for our group of ten. We had an amazing time and our tour guide, Agnes, was the best. She was very knowledgeable, passionate, and very funny. The tour to Montserrat and Finca Ca n’Estella winery were excellent, but Agnes made it all even more enjoyable.

Montserrat was really fun with amazing views. Agnes explained all of the history and toured us through the area. Then we were given free time to wander around on our own. Then at Finca Ca n’Estella winery, we were lucky enough to have the owner, Ana tour us with Agnes. She explained all of her family history and we could see her love of her wine and winery. We were assured this was not a normal occurrence, so we felt very privileged.

We needed to be at the airport for a 5pm flight, so Agnes picked us up a little earlier than usual and then kept in mind all day that we needed to be at the airport at a certain time.

Tour: A+
Winery: A+
Agnes: A+++

From the word go, this tour was great. We got a snappy & fun mini guide of Barcelona history, and then got taken to the funicular railway, which took us up to the monastery. The views were breathtaking and everything was timed perfectly. Our guide Aila was so lovely, very knowledgeable and really made herself available. The wine-tasting was just right, not too little and not too much, the food was perfect, and again Aila educated us about grape varieties, the influence of the weather and the history of the vineyard. An excellent day, well worth the money.

This tour was the highlight of our visit to Barcelona. Both Montserrat and the winery were amazing. But what made the experience a success was the excellence of our guides, Maria Valles and Pol. Both were very personable and knowledgeable. Maria is a dynamo. She's an exceptional presenter, funny and forceful at the same time. Her pride in the Catalan culture shone through, as well as her joy in sharing it with us. Pol is a wine superstar. CNN should hire him to replace Anthony Bourdain and do wines tours of the world.

We really enjoyed the tour to Montserrat which was beautiful and scenery amazing. We also had a bit of free time to walk around.
Then on to the winery which included a Tapas lunch and wine tasting, again very enjoyable.
Our tour guide Sylvia was lovely, very informative and funny, she had only been doing the tours for a month ..we were surprised as she was so knowledgeable about the whole tour. Definitely recommend this tour.

We were excited to experience Montserrat and the wine tasting but the trip turned into much more! Traffic kept us from making the train to Montserrat but we were delighted to be treated to a cable car ride to the top. Very exciting! The best part of the trip was our tour guide, Lorenzo. He was very knowledgeable about everything - geology, history, wine, current affairs, art! He was terrific and made the trip so much more enjoyable!

This tour was one of the highlights of our trip to Barcelona. Marta was a wonderful tour guide. She is very personable and knowledgable, with a spark of humor,which was much appreciated. Marta treated all of us as very welcomed guests and made the experience memorable. Monsarrat was beautiful with amazing views and we enjoyed the historical information as well as the free time to explore on our own. The winery tour was filled with interesting historical information about the family, the area and the wine making process,and the wine /food tasting was so much fun.
Albert was amazing! He gave us a wonderful and informative tour of wine and country! Would absolutely recommend this tour and Albert!

Took the Montserrat tour with Tapas and Wine; our guide was Jordi.

The bus was clean, the seats were comfortable and the commentary was interesting and very well presented (it was just the right amount of commentary).

I would recommend this tour to everyone wanting great customer service, a wonderful light meal, fantastic wine and amazing scenery.

We are vegetarians, we were pleasantly surprised by the vegetarian option provided.

The tour was great value! We are so glad we did it through this company.

My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our day visiting Montserrat. We received a "highlights" tour of the monastery and surroundings from our excellent guide, Albert, including commentary as we left the heart of Barcelona. Since we had opted for the 1/2 day tour we had just ~45 minutes to explore on our own. We took advantage of the time by going for a short hike up the hill to stretch our legs and take in the beautiful views. After leaving Montserrat we went to a local winery and had a delicious tapas lunch with our wine tasting. Albert was as informed about the wines as he was the monastery. Our fellow visitors on the tour were a friendly and engaging group. A delightful day!

We had the best time during this tour! Our guide was Albert and he did an amazing job! Would recommend this to anyone who wants to learn a little bit about wine production and Barcelona and taste some amazing wine. Such a great experience!

My partner and I did this tour last week, it was just fab!
Montserrat is just amazing, it was very foggy up there but we still saw most of the monastery.
Our tour guide was Xavi, who did a fantastic job. Kept our interest in the history of Spain and Montserrat. Xavi said he loves his job, well it certainly shows! Thanks Xavi! Lewis joined us later to go to the castle and winery to do wine tasting and eat tapas. That was great fun and the boys did a great job, my boyfriend and I bought 4 bottles of wine and beer! Thanks for such a great day, very memorable!

The whole experience was wonderful and made even more spectacular because of our wonderful tour guide Sandra. She was engaging, very knowledgeable and obviously loves what she does. I have been to many wine tastings and found Sandra’s presentation and knowledge of the wines to be excellent. Thank you Sandra for a great experience.
Bethel Sturdy

Your tour was Amazing!  I was very impressed with everything from the tour guides to the destination and of course the wine tasting.   Pep was very professional and very funny. I will not hesitate to use your company again when we come back.

Thank your for a great experience, one that we will never forget!

We could not have asked for a better adventure! Everything was done effortlessly, and professionally.
Pep wins as our favorite guide. He was easy-going, friendly, and very knowledgeable about Barcelona, Montserrat and a great deal of history.

This was a wonderful tour! Easily found the Hard Rock which was the meeting point. Very informative bus ride to the cog wheel train. Tour guides were very knowledgeable. We got an hour tour of the monetary and then time on our own. After returning to parking lot on the cogwheel train we boarded the bus and drove to a winery. We had very a very good selection of tapas with wine pairings, then a tour of the winery. The bus took us back to the Hard Rock. We would definitely recommend this tour...Montserrat is beautiful!!!

In September while spending a few days in Barcelona, my sister and I booked a day tour to Montserrat with tapas and wine. We started the day meeting the Castle Experience tour representatives at Plaza Catalunya as instructed prior. Very shortly we boarded a comfortable bus with our lovely tour guide Aurora. As we drove, approx. 30 minutes to Montserrat, we were provided with history along the way. The bus dropped us off at the cog wheel train station which we rode to the top to get to the monastery. I can't say enough about our guide Aurora.Her knowledge of wine growing and production was impressive and the nicest lady! We had a wine tasting outside then proceeded indoors for a look at the wine cellar then on to the tasting room. The tapas and wine provided was amazing! I had advised in advance that I had a dairy allergy and special non-dairy food was waiting for me at the table and it was delicious and very much appreciated. The bus ride back to Barcelona was equally enjoyable. A very enjoyable, memorable day!

This was our first ever tour. Admittedly, we aren’t really tour people. The staff was great, the bus was comfortable and the winery was nice. My girlfriend and I aren’t really the “touring” type of couple, but we couldn’t have had a better time on this tour. Great experience for the price, and the places you go see are very cool. If you have a trip planned to Barcelona that is at least 4 days long, I would definitely add this into your schedule (I say 4 days, because had we been there 3 days, our personal decision would have been to check out the other attractions in the city of Barcelona).

Our guide was Alex who was clearly very passionate about his job and was genuine in his approach. His commentary was in an easy to understand style and entertaining. He loved the winery and was quite knowledgeable about what he was telling us.

One of the other guides was Xavi who was also very entertaining in his commentary on the bus. Plus we learnt lots.

It was a great day we got to meet some fun people and had an entertaining experience. This was a highlight of our Barcelona visit. Thanks Alex and Xavi - you are the best we’ve seen so far.

Our tour guide Pol Salamo was very knowledgeable. We learnt so much about history of Barcelona and Monserratt. The tour started on time and was well organised during the trip. Lovely train trip up the mountain. Wine tasting and tapas was great. Once again Pol's knowledge of wine making was excellent.
Good value tour.

First off, I have to say this company has fine-tuned every aspect of this tour to make it incredible. We did the Extended tapas, winery and Monserrat tour. We arrived at the meeting point outside of the Hardrock hotel to check in. We were asked if we had any dietary restrictions and then the person checking us in took us to our guide where we all introduced ourselves. Our tour guide was Pol and he was very friendly and knowledgable. The bus to Monserrat was waiting for us and we left on time. Once at Monserrat, Pol gathered our group and we took the cogwheel train up to the monastery. It was such a beautiful ride up. I really liked that Pol gave us his business card as well in case we needed him for anything. We did the hike up to the cross which I highly recommend. Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Barcelona.

Last month my girlfriend's took me on my bachelorette to Spain and booked this tour for us. We absolutely loved this day trip! After a very comfortable bus ride we arrived at the train station that took us up the mountain. Having done a few group tours, this one exceeded expectations from the descriptions we read. The meeting place was a convenient location, and the transportation was comfortable. Pol was the leader of our small group and led this historic talks on the bus--he did a great job with both. His knowledge and passion for Barcelona were apparent but not overbearing. The visit to Montserrat is wonderful and included a liquor tasting and small snack. You have the option of doing some hiking, which is a bit steep. The winery experience was educational and relaxing. Tasting wine in a castle is a one of a kind experience, and the wine was great! I would highly recommend this experience for adults, probably not a good experience for kids that can't enjoy wine or be quiet on a bus.

Great trip and tour! Maybe the best I’ve ever been on. Our guide, Xavi, made it all possible by providing excellent service and great information. Everything was cool coordinated and the transportation was great, safe, and clean. The views, the church, and the museum were breathtaking.

Where do I even start... Carol our tour guide was AWESOME. She was so knowledgeable of the monastery, the wine and the food/things to do in Montserrat. Anyway, I can's say enough good things about this tour and our tour guide. Definitely go if you get a chance.

This tour is so far the best one I had in my trip. Our guide Ana was very knowledgeable, funny, and helpful. We enjoy the beautiful views and learned interesting facts. We had a great time, and some good glasses of wine.  I highly recommend this tour.

Great tour very well organized. Would highly recommend. Our tour guide Ana was great, she made the tour very interesting and informative! I would definitely use this company again the next time we come.
