I'd like to give a big 'shout-out' to Pol, my group's leader, he was absolutely fantastic! Pol was knowledgeable and very personable. I would recommend this highly! :)

With only 4 days in Barcelona we thought long and hard before taking most of a day outside the city. So glad we decided to do so! Perhaps because the weather was lousy, we (a group of 5) wound up with our own personal guide, Agnes. Agnes is literally everything you could ask for in a guide: knowledgeable, articulate, respectful of the members of the tour, funny (very funny!) and super passionate about her city and region. Go Agnes!

The tour itself is very well organized. Meet in front of the Hard Rock cafe in Plaza de Catalunya (just look for the pink hand-held umbrella). There's a comfortable hour-long ride in a tour bus, in the beginning with excellent descriptions of the city and its history, then some silence for a snooze while you complete the journey. Then off the bus and onto a "zipper" train (you'll understand why they call it that once you see it) to Montserrat. Don't confuse that with the funicular, which goes from the monastery to the top of the mountains (an additional €8, which we didn't spend but would have had it not been so fogged in).

After a quick orientation to the history and use of the monastery and surroundings, as well as some ideas for you to explore, you're freed for a little over an hour for exploration. We split up, some of us hiking to the Cross of San Miguel (awesome views) and some exploring the church.

If you're there on the right day, do not miss the boys' choir, which sings for about 10 minutes at 1pm sharp. You'll need to arrive very early to be able to sit down for it, but even if you just pack into the crowd in the back you'll get a sense as to why it's considered to be the second best in the world. Beautiful!

Note: if your passion is to touch the Black Madonna, this tour does not provide enough time to do so.

Then, reconvene with your guide and mount a bus to descend the hills to the winery. We've done a few wine tours and they all have their strong points, but this was a terrific experience even against some of the best you can do in Italy. The wines were excellent (as were the tapas - btw they will accommodate vegetarians, just ask), but more so because they were so intensely Catalan in their origin and passion. Beautiful castle dating back ten centuries, occupied by the same family for over 30 generations. Agnes used the wines and castle to provide an even more in depth exploration of the culture and history of Catalunya (without losing sight of the fact that this was really about the wines).

After a leisurely walk around the castle and an opportunity to purchase some of the wines, back to another comfy bus to return to Barcelona, again about an hour with a little bit of talk and a lot of napping.

Everyone in our group (some in their 20s, some in their 50s) very much enjoyed this experience. Couldn't have asked for more.
The views from Montserrat were beautiful and breathtaking. Well worth the trip. The mountains have a very unique shape and characteritics.
This tour was amazing. Beautiful views and amazing food with a great guide. We had a phenomenal time and it was the highlight of our trip to Barcelona

This tour went above and beyond my expectations! First, Monserrat is gorgeous and completely worth visiting when you’re in the area. I would not skip visiting in some form. But this tour gives you so many views and different angles of the site during the day, too! I don’t know if you could get that on other tours. Second, the winery is unique and exceptional. You really get a cool experience at this site. Very scenic, full of history, feels totally private. Third, the tour guides (we had Clara) are wonderful! I would go on this tour again if I could.

My best friend and I just finished the Monserrat + winery tour with Dani and can't recommend it enough. The entire day was amazing - first a wonderful wine tasting at a CASTLE vineyard with an amazing view of the mountains in the distance. Wine was great, too. Then a short ride up to the truly breathtaking Monserrat. The foggy rainy day we caught just added to the awesome atmosphere. Watching the boys choir sing in the basilica was truly a highlight. The entire tour was very smooth and well-coordinated. The bus ride was comfortable, the group was small, and our guide, Dani, was so knowledgable and was a pleasure to chat with. The guides are knowledgable. The busses are new and comfortable. Montserrat was pretty but very commercialized. Lunch was mediocre or at best. The winery was beautiful as well but the tour of the grounds was limited.

We had a great time on our trip to the two wineries with our tour guide, Simon. Simon was super knowledgable about all things wine and Spain and didn't mind answering all of our questions. Despite leaving Barcelona early, the experience overall is so amazing so don’t let the time discourage you. Xavi was my tour guide and he’s kind, funny and very informative. I didn’t realize how beautiful the views were going to be when we got to Montserrat, this tour became a lot more than just wine. I'd recommend it to anyone going to Barcelona for more than 4 days. The guides were knowledgeable, the wine and tapas were amazing, and I love that it wasn't exactly a guided tour every minute.. we had moments to walk around on our own which was nice.
Great tour, Merak our guide was fantastic, very passionate about the history of Monserrat and the wine and tapas in the region
Excellent trip. Very informative. Great views. Laura was a great guide. Interactive, fun. Winery good.

We loved the experience, the tour was fantastic and we felt we were in good hands with our Guide Pep.

We recommend it!

Really amazing tour, our tour guide Aina was fantastic, she was so knowledgeable and was happy to answer any questions we had. The tour was on national Catalonia day, a special day in Catalonia, so the history lesson we received on the bus on the travel there was nothing short was amazing by Aina. Montserrat was beautiful with some real spectacular views, and I would definitely recommend trying some of the local farmers cheeses!
Would 100% recommend this tour

WE left Plaza Catalonia at 9:30 and went to Montserrat. Our tour guide, Albert Perez, was exceptional. In the one hour ride, on and off, he delighted us with 2000 years of history of Barcelona and Catalonia, including literature and anecdotes. There was not enough time to see everything. We chose the Museum and the Basilica. The museum surprised us with Caravaggio's St Jerome and wonderful postmodernism. In the Basilica we enjoyed a very moving concert by Montserrat Boys' Choir.

Time in Montserrat could have been longer.

Then we went for wine tasting in Can Bonastre. Beautiful place. Nice cabernet. The white a bit sweet for me.

Our guide did an excellent job with a sincere and informative commentary. I am pleased that we did this tour as it saved any hassles. However the guide (no complaints) gave us the tour of the winery, explained the wine tasting and the " Tapas" plate all of which was accomplished without any input whatsoever from Winery staff. I found that very disappointing as it fell short of my expectations and the experience enjoyed on other Winery Tours.
The "Tapas" was anything but; consisting of a small plate of thinly sliced cheese, cold meats and a bowl of olives, all of which were quite nice. Nothing had been cooked or resembled traditional tapas.
If you are after a traditional experience, you will be disappointed; it comes close to false advetising!

The entire day was great! Beautiful sights, really enjoyed the farmers market and liqueur tasting (bought things from both to take home!), and we had an amazing tour guide (Mercedes!). Learned a lot about wine too. The monastery and mountain were just beautiful! Highly recommend!

We had a great tour. We have visited Montserrat where we were able to see the black Madonna. And then we went to the wine tasting in Oller del Mas. They have such a tasty wine. The tour guide was so helpful and friendly. He made our journey unforgettable.
The tour was great and the guide Toni is very friendly and so nice. He has a bulk of information and he answered every question straight to the point.
Ales-Guide great. Well planned.100% recommended. Winery superb. Good transportation and free time adequate.

Upside:
Pickup points and references were very straight forward. No guessing.
Tour guide was very knowledgeable, friendly & patient.
The monastery atop the mountain was amazing. Needed a little more time to explore the market and tram to the top. Hike to the cross was fabulous. Liquor tasting was a nice treat.
Wine tasting was good. New facility so still working out some bugs but nothing that would/should deter.
Downside: none. We were very happy with the overall experience.

We had the great fortune of having Merak Villa as our guide for our 9 person tour. Honestly, we could have looked at a tree and he would have made it fastinating - he had the passion , energy and knowledge every step of the trip and always added his personal views which added that extra layer. Montserrat has to be seen to be believed - amazing for all ages and different levels of walking/climbing based on fitness level. We spent just the right time there for first trip (could easily spend a day or more if going to museum as well). It was then off to the very historic Winery - now in its 37 generations - brand new (1 day old!) tasting facility/gift shop etc - the Tapas were good and plentiful.
The tour was easy to find outside Hard Rock cafe - the leaders came just before the start so don't worry if they aren't there far in advance as they were there on time. It was nice being in a small group , bus ride was very comfortable and it all ran to time. Perfect day out .
The tour was well organized. All four guide were wonderful. We had so much fun. Will recommend the tour to friends and families .

We enjoyed this tour immensely, thanks in large part to our outstanding tour guide, Aina. Everything about the tour went like clockwork, with a relaxed manner throughout the day.

Montsarrat's history came alive during the tour, and I was especially interested in the starkly different geography and geology of the area. It's just breathtakingly beautiful.

The second part of the tour to a 1,000 year-old winery, with decidedly high-tech innovations in the winemaking process, was perhaps our most unusual winery visit. The tapas accompanying our wine tasting was unique in our experience, and Aina did a superb job of leading us through the session. She is knowledgeable, unpretentious, kind, considerate, and with an understated sense of humor.

This was one of the days that will stand out in our memories after our month-long stay in Europe is ended.

My fiancé and I had an amazing time on Toni’s Monserrat and wine/tapas tour. He is a very knowledgeable and engaging guide with a great sense of humor. The program itself was a perfect amount of information, free time, and wine. Would highly recommend the tour and Toni in particular!

Luke and Charlotte

Unforgettable day with Merak and team as our guides. Great landscape, amazing culture, good vino and fantastic tapas - all that represents this lovely country. Merak's presentation of the different wines and his passion for this ritual finished this day on an absolute high.
Thanks a lot to Merak and the entire team!!

the first highlight of this tour were the pink umbrellas that welcomed us in the morning at the meeting point; they cannot be overseen
already having my mind set on a day with wine, food and no worries, not even having to think about the meeting location already started my day off greatly

even though I had already been to Montserrat a couple of times, our guide Toni still told us many interesting things that I did not know and made me experience that place a bit different

also, even though I rather enjoy drinking wine than collecting information about it, I loved receiving some knowledge about Catalan wine and certain aspects of the production process, especially because Toni did such a good job keeping everyones´ attention and interest
the winery was so beautiful and idyllic (there are also donkeys) that I was tempted to ask for a job and stay there forever

in addition to the already wonderful tour, the bus so new and comfortable, I had to test it for a little nap on the way back and slept beautifully

In my opinion, the guides of Castlexperience are some of the most fun and loving people that I have met on my journey in Barcelona and would recommend a tour to anyone who wants to make unforgettable memories of this magnificent country

My sister and I recently visited Barcelona, but wanted to get out of the city to explore a bit so we booked a trip to Montserrat. We were NOT disappointed in the least bit. We met in a central location and easily found our tour group. We were divided into groups and assigned a designated guide. We were lucky to receive Dani, who was knowledgeable, kind, and had a GREAT sense of humor. We learned a lot about the history of Montserrat and the monastery and were given plenty of time to explore on our own. We then went to the winery where we had a generous amount of wine tasting with a beautiful view and tapas. The tapas portion was slightly disappointing (plate of cheese, meats, a few pastries; bread with tomato spread, olives, potato salad, and dessert, which was a type of cheesecake). It was filling, but I had imagined a better spread of tapas. Overall, the trip was lovely and I would recommend it to anyone visiting Barcelona! Shout out to Dani, who was truly the best guide ever!

I did this tour with my girlfriend and we had a super good time. The monastery is beautiful as well as the mountain. After that we went to a small castle with vineyards and had a great tapas lunch, that was delicious, and wine tasting. We really enjoyed this tour so I want to thank Castle Experience for this and also our guide Dani, who was super fun and told us a lot of interesting facts throughout the tour.
Toni is a good tour guide always take care of the people who join the tour. He also good at the history and landscape story telling! The tapas and wine are amazing! strong recommend!!

Maria is our guide! She is really great and makes us feel very comfortable. She explains the history of the Montserrat very clearly! The tapas with wine is also very great! The journey is extremely well-planned and we all had a great time!

Toni was the best tour guide!! He was very knowledgeable about the history of Montserrat and also the winery and how they make the wine!! I definitely plan to go again and take my family with me next time!!

Very good experience every one loves it.
We had a great time and kids had fun. Will recommend to everyone

Yesterday we had an amazing experience traveling with Clara from Barcelona to two wineries. Great transportation with a modern air conditioned beautiful bus, with Clara giving us interesting info about Barcelona and the wine areas we were visiting.
Wineries were wonderful....even met the owner Ana at one..who welcomed us into her home for a tasting of delicious Cava.
Clara is a gem...just so full of energy, passion and very warm. I recommend this company very highly...and thanks Clara for making our day!

Montserrat was just beautiful. The line to touch the Black Madonna was 3 hours long but we were able to take pictures inside the Basilica. The wine tasting took place at a castle/winery built in the 900’s and we tasted a nice variety. Our tour guide Mr. X was really nice as well.
I really enjoyed my day trip to Montserrat. The tour was the perfect way to see Montserrat and was well organized.
It was excellent tour to the Montserrat and excellent guide as well. Tour would have been even better if we could stayed a little bit more at the monestry.
We really enjoyed this tour. Agnes, our guide, was interesting, had amusing anecdotes and answered all our questions. The tapas and wine were delicious and plentiful.

I thought this was a well-done tour. It got us to Montserrat, gave us some info, let us free to make choices about what to see and do, etc. The monastery itself is beautiful as is the setting. I also enjoyed the wine tasting and tapas. Maria was my guide and she was excellent. Recommended!

My family of 5 enjoyed this tour very much. Our tour guide, Clara, was knowledgeable,friendly, and very accommodating to our 3 children under the age of 11. Our tour ran promptly with very little wait time, which we appreciated.

The views from Montserrat are incredible, as was the food and drink at the Oller del Mas winery. I liked how the day was arranged. The historical tour in the morning was very interesting while the winery tour in the afternoon was relaxed and laid back.

One thing to note: the winery is several kilometres away from the cathedral and requires a 30 minute bus ride to get there. The bus route is along a road with many twists and turns (it is the mountains, after all) so visitors who are prone to motion sickness should be aware.

Overall...an excellent experience!

This trip was extremely was organized. An easy bus trip took us to the monastery and then off to the vineyard for lunch and a wine tasting. Our guide Alex was fantastic- not only knowledgeable about wines and the history of the area but he helped us with great suggestions for the rest of our trip in Barcelona.
An amazing day trip and worth the money!

We did this day trip out of Barcelona during a heat wave that saw the temperature reach 104 degrees F which is pretty close to unbearable, however the views from Montserrat are simply amazing as the surrounding areas are lowlands so you have a wide open view of the surrounding area that few places can boast. Montserrat itself, is very beautiful, however; my girlfriend and I both believe the experience would be underwhelming without a guide to share the interesting history, as well as the artistic significance of the many areas of Montserrat. You really need someone knowledgeable to enhance your experience. Luis, our guide was very personable during the tour and even more knowledgeable when it came to the winery tasting, helping each individual to understand the nuances of each wine and give a broader understanding of wine culture in general. Also, very funny and you can tell that each one of the guides really love what they do and care about your experience. Definitely would recommend as long as you are not allergic to grapes/wine/fun!

Excellent value for money, Alex was a passionate and knowledgable guide, with excellent english language. Knew all about the monestory and the history of the wine vinyard and family. A good day out with lunch and wine included.

The entire tour was a lovely experience! Both Borja and Maria were delightful with great personalities and very knowledgeable. The timing of the day was well balanced, we never felt rushed or that we spent too much time somewhere but still got to see/do/taste everything we wanted to.

We found this excursion and tour to be a great time with Rubi as our guide and friend for the day. We had a small group and the tour at Montserrat was beautiful. Since we have returned to the States we have recommended this to two couples that will be Barcelona later this year. The tour gets you back to Barcelona to enjoy the evening and the great city that it is.

We spent an excellent day traveling from Barcelona to Montserrat and then to a great winery. Everyone at Castle Experience was great - from checking at the beginning to our excellent tour guide Rubi.

The monastery was amazing and the wine at the vineyard was delicious. I would recommend this tour to anyone who wants to see the Barcelona countryside.

Get picked up outside Hard Rock Cafe easy to find. Very friendly and knowledgeable tour guides. We had Ana....she was fantastic. Ask her anything and she can give you an answer. About a 50 minute coach trip then up up up the mountain on a special train. No good if you don’t like heights!! We trekked up to the ✝️ cross, which is about 20mins. Tough walk, wear some comphy shoes as it’s all up hill. Gets a little rough towards the top. Worth the views. Went into the church after the choir had finished, less crowded. Wine tasting and tapas was lovely. The group we had were a little quiet but a great experience.

We did the tapas option instead of full blown lunch tour because we knew we would have a snack at the monastery farmer's market as well as buy a snack for the ride home to Barcelona after the wine tasting. It was a great overall day with a short bus ride from Barcelona (includes some narration by guides about the history of the city and the area then quiet time to enjoy the scenery) followed by a nice guided tour of the monastery to provide history and context for the sites we were seeing. Our guide was Jordi and he was absolutely fantastic; he was from the Montserrat area originally so his commentary was especially authentic and enjoyable. He made our day much better than if we had tried to see the same sites on our own. After the monastery (we did the hike and got cheese from the farmer's market in our free time), we got on a bus again for a quick 20ish minute ride to the vineyard. The tapas and wine were delicious; the wine was organic so it was fun to learn about the production process and unique facts of the vineyard. Our tour included 3 courses with pairings (one white and 2 reds). Jordi explained each of the courses and was fun to chat with while we ate and drank. Can't say enough about his as a personal guide. The bus ride back to Barcelona and disembarking process was painless. We did this tour on our honeymoon trip and would recommend it for all couples or anyone of drinking age (a lot of adult family tourists on our tour with us).
Clara was so knowledgeable and such a fun tour guide! Wine and Cava was superb! An amazing day thanks to Clara! Thank you!

This tour was easily one of the best experiences that I've had while traveling abroad. Montserrat is just beautiful, and our guide Luis was awesome! One of the women in our group was recovering from surgery and was having some trouble with getting around the Monastery. Luis being so kind and absolutely adorable, took Señora Karen on her on little tour at a slower pace while the rest of the group had free time to wander and shop. The wine tasting was great and i had the best cheesecake EVER at the vineyard. Highly recommend if you're in Barcelona.

Aida was our tour guide & she couldn’t have been more pleasant & informative! I get car sick, didn’t take Dramamine (silly me) and she made sure we sat in the front. Aida is truly a gem & the tour was amazing. The 1000 yr old winery was a pure joy, being from the Napa area it was incredible to see how “new” Napa truly is to the wine industry. The only complaint I would have is that me personally, I don’t like being hurded in a group. Not that I don’t enjoy people but it was not a private type tour, our group was around 12 & for me, that was just too big. Had I known it would be like that we would have booked a private tour. Aida is a gem, she deserves a lot of accolades and appreciation for her amazing service. The bus drivers were great as well, but those curvy roads will get ya if you’re in any way prone to car sickness, bring your Dramamine! lol

We found out more about the history of Barcelona on our drive to Montserrat than anywhere else. Our guide's name was Pol and he was simply amazing. When we arrived at Montserrat, Pol continued to be very informative about the Bassilica and its history. In our free time we walked out to the cross on a peak which gave beautiful views across the valley as well as the buildings of Montserrat. We then went to a winery nearby and enjoyed a tapas lunch with generous tastings of 3 wines. Once again Pol was very informative and I learnt new thngs about wines (even though I come from wine country in Australia). I enjoyed the wines as well. This was an excellent tour that I would highly recommend.

This was an excellent tour! Montserrat Monastery was formidable, perched high in the Mountains . The Mountains were spectacular- serrated top, hence the name . The ride up to the Monastery in the cog-wheel train was fantastic! View superb. Our tour guide , Aina, was helpful, humorous and very knowledgeable. We took the “ lunch option”, rather than the Tapas. Lunch was served in a production line . Tour groups at tables of 10-12. Serving plates of salad came first ( not much of a salad), then the Patatas, and main couse was Cannelloni. 3 small cannelloni rolls , with cheese sauce . Dessert was a tasteless cup of plain yoghurt . It seemed like a cheap option. Perhaps the Tapas option would be better.
The wine tasting was fun, and our tour guide was an expert .
All in all, a great day - fantastic scenery , the Monastery was powerful.

We absolutely loved the Montserrat tour today with our guide Agnès!
It was a beautifull trip to the monastery and we enjoyed all the information we got during the bustrip towards Montserrat.

After we visited the monastery and enjoyed the siginging in the choir we got the the vineyard which was awesome as well. Again we loved all the information we received.

We could not have had a better day! Our special thanks to Agnès because she was so nice and enthousiastic all day.

@Agnès, thanks once more for this great day!

And for other tourists, this trip to Montserrat with Caste Experience is a must have on your holliday!

Hasta Luego!

We had a great time, Xavi was very forthcoming, friendly and funny and took us through the various stops very smoothly with a lot of info and a few jokes. Great time, great sights, amazing wine. Two thumbs up!

The tour was really awesome! Our guide Mercedes was awesome and made the tour special!

The daily tour is a lot of fun and the winery offers great food and great wines! It is really something special!

We had an exceptional tour of Montserrat and Oller del Mas from Barcelona! Our tour guide Jordi was incredibly knowledgeable and extremely accommodating. His knowledge of both destinations was impressive, and he made sure to share as much as possible during our trip. We will definitely look for Jordi when we come back to Barcelona with friends and family!

We all enjoyed our trip to Montserrat including the tapas and the wine tasting. Montserrat was beautiful to see and Albert was very knowledgable and friendly. We shared a coach with other groups and all the tour guides were friendly. Would highly recommend
Excellent day trip from Barcelona, beautiful scenery and excellent historical winery with wine and tapas. Danni was very friendly and entertained us for the day. Highly recommend.

Even though our reservation were last minute they were able to accommodate us. The guides were knowledgeable, friendly and fun. The buses were nice and clean and on time. I would highly recommend using this tour.

We enjoyed this. Our guide Alex had knowledge and his english was Good. We were specially amazed by Montaerrat, since We did not have any expectations. The wine and tapas was Good. We learned some new things about wine (since We knew very little). The winery was Good looking.

Carol was a fantastic tour guide. She is very sweet and funny. She was very accommodating and made sure to answer any questions we had. Our group was a mix of young and older people and she kept us moving at a pace that was great for everyone. We would definitely recommend the tour to anyone traveling to Barcelona. It was a nice day trip away from the busy city. By the end of our tour the whole group felt like our friends! 5 stars, thanks for a great experience!!!!! 😁

From the moment we got on the bus and our guide Jordi began talking, I knew it was going to be a good day. Jordi walked us through some of Catalonia’s history and let us know what to expect about the day’s adventures. His background, knowledge, and wit were all appreciated.

I enjoyed riding the cog wheel train (which I had recently read about in Dan Brown’s book Origin) up the mountain. The walk from the top to the monastery was invigorating. We learned about St George and about La Moreneta and their legends.
The monastery was impressive, as were the village giants who happened to be preforming in the square that morning. There was time to sample several traditional liquors and to shop at the street market.

Afterward we traveled by bus to Oller del Mas vineyards and cellar for a tour of the cellar and for wine and tapas. Jordi conducted the wine tasting with four generous pours, two whites and two reds. We enjoyed tapas between tastings. Wine was available for purchase but that was not a focus of the afternoon.

I enjoyed the casual atmosphere, the small number of people in the tour group, and the expertise of our guide.

I decided to do the tour because a group of family friends visited BCN a couple of months ago and they recommended me to try this experience.
This time, I visited BCN alone so I wanted to try the tour by myself.
I have to say that the day was really fast!! More than expected!! Tony was our guide and showed us how Montserrat is an amazing place with a lot of history and secrets!
He was very kindly all the time, he saw that I was alone and always tried to talk with me and make me feel like inside the group.
The wine tour was special with all the explanations about every one that we tried, Tony was really clear and simple with that, important thing also if u are not an expert in wines.
I really recommend you this tour and if you can choose Tony, do it! (I don't know if the possibility exists in the booking).

This tour was one of the highlights of our trip. It's well paced, and the combination of Montserrat and the winery is a good one. The scenery is unforgettable. Our tour guide, Alex, was excellent - his knowledge and enthusiasm enriched this experience.

Our tour was a great day. Met at designated location and left on time. Our tour guide, Agnes, was excellent! She provides great insight to Montserrat while also giving us ample free time. The wine tasting was good an there was the opportunity to purchase additional bottles at a very reasonable rate.

It was a very interesting experience and we really enjoyed the tour! Many thanks to the guide Ana, that gave us a lot of information and good suggestions about how to use your on 100%. Also she’s got brilliant English and nice sense of humor. Best regards:)

My wife and I took our first tour and it was absolutely amazing! The bus ride to Montserrat was only an hour and the views were spectacular winding along narrow mountain roads. They gave us ample time to view all the buildings and scenery, even gave us an hour to ourselves for whatever we would like to do.
Then it was on to tapas and wine tasting at an old castle that they provided a nice lunch. We just loved everything about our day, highly recommend using Castlexperience Wine Tours.

My husband and I loved this tour! It was one of our highlights of our trip to Barcelona. It was so well organized and professional. Everything went so smoothly, even for a large group with multiple tours. We never lost our group or felt confused. Borja was great! He was fun, energic, funny and gave a great explanation of the history of spain as well as the winery and montserrat. Often its the tour guide that can make or break your experience. Borja was honest and even told us what to buy and not to buy at the stores. We followed his advice and bought some great cheese from the local farm stand. The buses were clean and comfortable too (maybe the cleanest ive ever been on) I have already recommended this tour to a friend of mine who is planing a trip to Spain. I highly recommend this tour to anyone.

Wonderful experience. We loved every moment. Carol, our guide, and the other tour guides were wonderful and very informative. We learned a lot about every aspect of the tour, from religious meanings of Monserrat to Barcelona history to wine tasting notes. Carol was especially helpful when our group had questions about the wines of the region and helped us understand the rich history of the winery and built our appreciation for the tasting. Thank you!

This was a very well planned tour and the guides were excellent. Out Group's guide, Anna was super and she made an effort to know all our first names. Her knowledge of the history pertaining to the tour was very good. The whole experience was awesome and my wife and adult son really had a great time. Would have loved to take the cable car up and come down by the bus instead of bus both ways. The views were spectacular.

Monserrat and Wine-Tasting Tour. Albert
Fantastic Tour. We took a bus tour to the Benedictine monk monastery mountain retreat in Montserrat about an hour’s bus ride outside of Barcelona, followed by a wine-tasting at a local winery. Our well-informed guide, Albert, was organized and friendly, making it a thoroughly enjoyable experience. We highly recommend him.

I enjoyed everything about this tour. It was flawlessly organized and very informative. Our guide, Aina, had truly encyclopedic knowledge about history, people and wine. I believe, trip to Barcelona would be incomplete without visiting Montserrat. Highly recommend this great tour.

We were a Group of four. Absolutely loved this tour! The views were spectacular! The wine and tapas were excellent. Our tour guide Aurora was simply amazing. She gave us a wealth of information all the time with a great sense of humor. I would tour with her again anytime. Our bus driver was exceptional and believe me our lives were in his hands on those twisty roads going up the mountain. The train ride through the mountain was an added bonus and I think should be on every trip to this amazing place. Don’t miss it or you’ll be sorry.

Me and my 3 siblings took this tour during our week long trip to Barcelona. It was easy to book, arrive, and travel to Monserrat as well as the winery. Our tour guide Marta was the best! She was extremely knowledgeable about all topics covered on this tour. On our way out of Barcelona she gave us a historical overview of how the city came to be. In Monserrat she gave an awesome tour and we learned so many things while we were there. At the winery she gave us the history of the family who owns the winery and also showed us how to truly taste, date, and examine wines like pros! She did all of this with passion and a smile. When we return to Barcelona, we hope to see her again!!! Thank you for making our trip extra special on this tour!!!

I love this trip, the guide Toni was amazing, full of knowledge and tips to get a really unforgettable experience. Montserrat is beautiful and the views from the winery(and the wine) are stunning!
The only reason why I didn't give 5 starts is because I would like to spend a little bit more time in Montserrat.

My group of 6 had a great time on our tour to Montserrat and the winery. We loved our tour guys Alex. He was personable, friendly, super outgoing and always had a smile on his face! He definitely added to the quality of our trip. We loved the tour, had lots of cheese, liquor and wine all day! We had an hour of free time to explore on our own at Montserrat, but do wish we had about 30 minutes longer. Overall, it was a great experience. The highlight of our vacation.

We took the tour with 3 course lunch option. Well worth it, if only for the smaller group size / more attention from the guide, as the tapas groups were a little larger for most of the day.

We talked to three guides -- Clara, Aurora, and a young dude whose name I have sadly lost. All were very smart, very laid back, willing to talk about anything we were curious about. They gave some history / context for the area on the bus, and then we split into groups on arrival. Clara showed us around -- the tour was pretty informal, in a good way.

The monastery was busy in March, I can only imagine it in the summer. We did a spin through the basilica, walked up to the cross on the hill during free time, then headed to the winery for lunch. The food (and wine during the meal) were average, but the setting is fun, we had a great time with other folks on the tour. The wine tasting after lunch and tour of the winery itself was great. It's a beautiful setting, great backdrop.

Well worth the money to get a pass at Montserrat and the winery with very little effort required, with a chance to talk to the guides, as long as you don't mind the general Tour With a Million Other Americans vibe.

Our tour guide, Francesc, definitely made the experience! He gave us some great historical information about the area and Montserrat. He was also very funny and entertaining! The view from the monastery was beautiful and Oller del Mas winery was amazing! Beautiful small winery about 30 minutes away from the mountains with some delicious wine that we got to enjoy with our group. Would recommend as a day tour if you are visiting Barcelona.

Great experience over all. The views, the information given by xavi the best tour guide and food/wine it was all amazing and well worth the price. I will be doing this tour again but doing the full day instead because the half day was not enough to enjoy these beautiful location. Thank you Xavi for being super funny and informative.

Toni was an outstanding guide from start to finish. The tour started on time (which is always welcome). Toni made all of us feel welcome right from the start. (We had people from the US, Vietnam, England and Russia) Toni provided narration as we drove through and out of Barcelona, but not too much. Things went smoothly as we rode the train up Monserrat (note: it was a very smooth ride—not like some of the cog wheel trains in parts of the US). He explained our options for free time and we split up. I stayed with him as we walked us through parts of the monestary. A tasting of Monserrat liqueurs came with our ticket—definitely do that! The ride to the wine tasting was lovely and once we got there it just got better. Toni , again, did a great job explaining the food and wine pairings. Wish we could have spent more time there. It was a lovely estate. The wine was outstanding (I bought a bottle, as did another guy in our group). Just perfect all the way around. The weather helped, but Toni really made the whole thing feel special. Highly recommend!

My friend and I took the tour to Monserrat and the winery.
It was the best thing we did in Spain!
The Abbey at Monserrat is spectacular, the views from the mountain go on forever.
We had a great small group...a couple dro Australia, two lovely ladies from Germany, another couple from Virginia and us from Philadelphia.
We had a fabulous tapas lunch at the winery and laughed and shared travel stories.
The best part of the tour was our guide Borja! He was so knowledgeable about everything we saw and the wines we tasted. Borja made the tour so much fun.
Next trip to Barcelona we’re booking another with this gentleman.
Try to book with Mr. X! A funny and very knowledgeable guide. He made our Montserrat and winery experience very enjoyable!

My friend and I booked this trip and we were beyond happy with the service! Dani was funny, informative, and accommodating for the entire tour. We had a blast, and would recommend it to any of our friends coming to Barcelona who want to get out of the city for a day.

This tour blew away expectations. Our tour guide, Alex, was charming and knowledgeable, filling us in first on the history of Barcelona and then the history of Montserrat. We were blessed with a perfect spring day and the views took our breath away. The Monastery is such a lovely combination of man-made splendor framed by natural beauty. Hearing the stories of how St Ignatius of Loyola was healed at the shrine and went on to found the Jesuits and the history of the damage done by Napoleon's troops and the efforts to hide the Black Madonna made the trip so much more meaningful. The trip to the vineyard following the monastery tour was also a delight. Starting with the scenic descent of the Montserrat mountains and continuing with wine-tasting and tapas in a beautiful setting -- it was an experience to savor in every way! My college-aged daughter who is studying in Barcelona enjoyed this as as much as I did so it has broad appeal. Take the tour -- you'll be glad you did!

The small group makes this tour very appealing, we were only 12, which means there wasn't a lot of wasted time waiting for people. Merak is a great guide with a wealth of knowledge and insight. He gave a tour of the site and we still had plenty of time to explore on our own. Be sure to the hear the Boys Choir concert!
The wine and tapas were a great experience. It was just our group in a wine cellar, eating and talking about wine. It was very informal with Merak as our host; almost as if he were sharing his favorite wines with us in his home.

This is a definite "must do" when you are in Barcelona. We recently did the Montserrat Tour with Wine tasting and tapas and it was one of the best things we did! We had an extremely knowledgeable and personable tour guide, Luis, who shared with us a wealth of information on Montserrat as well as the winery, Oller Del Mas. I was extremely impressed how well organized everything was , from the cleanliness of the bus, to the attentiveness of the Staff(Primarily Luis), to again the wealth of information Luis shared with us. Thank you!!!

We did the half day to Monserrat and tapas and wine-tasting. Our guide was Agnes and she was a wealth of information and very personable. Monserrat was beautiful. The tapas at the winery was great and the wine tasting a lot of fun. I would definitely recommend the tour and thanks again to Agnes. You were great!

if you have seen most of the things in barcelona, this tour is highly recommended.
the view of the mountains is fantastic.

The tour was one of the best I have taken in my life owing much to the guide, Pep. He is young but very caring, intelligent and informative telling us whole histories of Catalugna, the monastery and the castle winery, with pleasant jokes. Without him, the trip would have been a rather boring one. Thank you, Pep!

We met at the Hard Rock Cafe..easy to get to by taxi from our hotel
It was a fabulous and informative tour with our tour leader Marek. He made our tour fun with enough time to explore Montserrat monastery on our own.The Tapas and wine were delicious at the gorgeous winery with it's fabulous views
Would highly recommend this tour company and our great leader Marek
Lorraine and Peter

The views from Montserrat were gorgeous. Pep was incredibly knowledgeable and personable, hope he is your guide, too! The tour of the winery and wine tastings were also great. It was a great trip away from the city and the perfect amount of time. Highly recommend!

Best $100 ever spent! My 10 friends and I did this together this past week. Our tour guide was MR. X and he was absolutely amazing. He was so funny, knowledgeable and a ton of fun, he made the tour a great time. Montserrat was the most beautiful place any of us had ever seen it truly took your breath away. We did the lunch option which was delicious the food was amazing!!! This day trip was the best thing we did, if you are visiting spain you have to do this tour!

The tour to Montserrat was wonderful and the bus to and from was modern and clean. Aurora our guide was very witty and truly made our tour amazing. She had plenty of knowledge and was very flexible. The wine tasting and tapas was really fun and a great way to get to know others in the tour. I would definitely recommend this tour.

The Montserrat and Wine Tour was definitely the highlight of my trip. The views from Montserrat were jaw-dropping amazing. Our tour guide, Dani, was extremely friendly, outgoing, and smart. He definitely made the tour super fun. The wine tour was blissful as we sipped on great wine, learned how the wine is made, had an amazing tour of the castle, and had yummy tapas. The tapas were tasty/filling enough and included dessert. If I ever go to Barcelona again, I would take this your all over again!! I cannot recommend this enough!!
We had a lovely day spent out of the city & in the lovely mountains of Monteserrat. Borja was our guide. He was very friendly & very knowledgeable. The wine tour & tapas was also very nice.

We loved having Dani as our tour guide. It's become more rare to have tour guides from the actual city, so we particularly liked hearing his family stories and traditions that related to the places we visited.

Thanks!

Great day trip, Broken up over two segments. The first Part is the Montserrat Monastery, the second segment consists of a wine tasting, tapas and a overview of a one thousand year old winery. Great tour guides, our guide Borja was fantastic. If you are going to do one day trip from this is the one. Jolly Chriss.

When one travels to Barcelona you could probably spend the entire week looking up things to do and eat. That being said taking a day trip outside of Barcelona to Montserrat is absolutely worth it and a nice change of pace from all of the insanity of the city. Simon the tour guide was awesome. He was energetic and educational in a fun and engaging way. The time flew by and before we knew it our tour was over. Simon gave us free time which was also appreciated since it allowed us to better know the locale at our own pace. I would recommend to not only go on this tour but try and have Feliciano as your guide. He’ll make it all worth it.

P.S. let me just add that this was by far and away my favorite tour of our visit to Barcelona. Simon’s talents make him my favorite tour guide of this trip.

If you like small group tour, personal attention and great food, this is the tour for you. We went to Montserrat with this guided tour because we didn’t want to worry about finding our way there! We started right in front of the Hard Rock Cafe, boarded the bus and along the way being entertained by the guides! There are five guides on our giant bus, each with his or her own group but we are all heading to Montserrat but with different itinerary! Our guide Alex took great care of each and everyone of us with different questions or needs. He was great in handling everyone very patiently! The tour company is very accommodating too! On our tour, one woman actually forgot her backpack and left it at Montserrat. Alex was able to locate it and offered to take her back on the bus the next day to pick it up for free! Now that’s service!
Our lunch which was included in our tour was exceptional! Delicious and sumptuous! Much better than expected.
I Highly recommend this tour.

We booked this tour in advance of our visit to Barcelona. Our guide Pep was very knowledgeable about the history of Barcelona and the surrounding area on the road to Montserrat. The views from the cog wheel train on the way up to the Monastery are amazing. When we arrived at the Monastery Pep explained the history of the Monastery in detail and shared information about the ‘Black Madona’. When we arrived at the Castle and vineyard we had a welcome drink and tasted local cheese. The tapas was good and the wine tasting was enhanced by Pep’s knowledge of the wines we were tasting. Overall an excellent day trip we would recommend to anyone visiting Barcelona.

We had such a great time. Pol was fantastic and very friendly. I feel like we accomplished so much in a short period of time. He had all the right answers to our questions and made the wine tasting a very intimate experience. My wife and I were the youngest people on the tour by easily 20 years (I’m 32 she’s 29) and we felt right at home.
We had just enough time at Montserrat to taste some liquor and hike to mirador at the cross. I can’t emphasize how much we enjoyed wine and tapas, my wife had the vegetarian selection and it looked delicious, needless to say I enjoyed my meat/cheese bread. We both learned a lot and felt the day was a great success!

We decided to take this tour the evening before and we were so grateful that we did. While visiting Montserrat our guide, Pep, gave us great information about the space and it's history. Pep was wonderful because he was extremely knowledgable about Barcelona's history, Montserrat and wine.

Additionally, we had an amazing time at the Vineyard and the Tapas were to-die-for. We'd definitely recommend this tour to any of our friend. We were back in Barcelona by 5 p.m. which was perfect.

During our recent trip to Barcelona, we took the Monserrat tour w tapas and wine and it was beyond amazing. The meet up location was easy to find and very well organized and the tour was absolutely flawless. Xavi, our tour guide, was absolutely incredible. He was knowledgable and funny. We loved being part of his group! He knew so much history and also so much about wine, he really made the trip amazing. He even gave great recommendations for things to do while in Barcelona and things to skip, which were super helpful. Also, all the logistics of the trip were so well thought out everything was on time and we were able to see all the things we wanted to see while in Monserrat. We recommend this tour to all our friends who are going to Barcelona, and were so glad to be part of it during our trip.

We enjoyed this trip very much. We started on time and the rest of the trip ran like clockwork. Pep was our tourguide and he did a great job of explaining the history of the monastary as well as the winemaking process. The bus was comfortable. The monastary was interesting and we were given an hour to explore by ourselves after Pep gave us the history. The winery tour included five wine tastings and a nice sampling of tapas.

Borja was a great guide- good energy and kept us engaged. I had just gotten in that morning, so I slept every minute we were on the bus, but our tour of Motserrat was wonderful and informative. I wish we had had a tiny bit more time- we only had an hour to try to do everything. Still, I managed to hit the farmers market, try the local liquors and see the boys choir. If you hustle, you can make it work.

The wine and tapas were phenomenal. The castillo was beautiful and historic and they provided me with Gluten Free pintxos when I requested. The food was delicious and the views amazing.

Luis was our guide and the best guide of our 16 day journey! He started with introducing each couple to the group, he was funny, serious, knowledgeable and a guide I would want on every tour. This tour is a must. Montserrat is the most unusual and beautiful place ever! The entire experience - the cathedral, the train, the winery...if you miss this tour you missed Spain!

This is a must do if you are visiting Barcelona and want to get away from the hectic city experience. We had a great day! Our visit started with a trip to the beautiful monastery on top of the mountains, providing great views of the valleys and cities in the distance. We then headed to the winery which was in a 1000 year-old castle. We really enjoyed the tapas and wines and even bought a couple of bottles to enjoy later. Our guide, Sandra, was awesome! She was engaging and entertaining and had a wealth of knowledge, not only about Montserrat, but of the wines as well. We highly recommend this tour.

This tour was amazing. Clara was the best tour guide during my stay in barcelona! She was super knowledgeable and personable made it a great day! The monestary was beautiful and the winery was great... a must do if you want to get out of the city .....I did the tapas option which got me back to barcelona at 530 and still had a full evening to go to dinner and explore more!

My boyfriend and I booked this tour for my birthday, and it was incredible! Our tour guide was Pol, he was friendly and extremely knowledgeable about Montserrat and the history of Spain. We learned a lot of great information about the monastery. The views were breath taking and we definitely enjoyed being able to have some free time to walk around and explore.

The winery was wonderful! Again, Pol was able to answer all of our questions about wine and even conducted our wine tasting which was very impressive! This full day tour was well worth it!

I was really happy I decided to book this tour during my stay in Barcelona. My tour guide, Agnes, made the trip fun and informative and made us really appreciate the beauty of Monserrat. The group was small which was nice. I thought we had the perfect amount of time at the winery and in the mountains, however if you want to be in Monserrat longer definitely do the full day tour.

We had a very nice day on our Monserrat tour. Our guide, Xavi, was great. He had a great balance of information and humor. The bus, and tram were very comfortable. My only complaint was the tapas. It was not great, looked like it had been sitting out for quite a while. The wine however, was very good!

Me and my fiancé booked this tour before traveling to Barcelona because of the good reviews, and we were not disappointed !

The trip was well organized and our guide Borja was brilliant! :) The view at the top of the mountain was spectacular!! The visit at the vineyard was also great, with vine tasting and tapas on the side. We also bought some Wine to bring back to Norway.

We would recommend this tour to anyone.

My fiance and I got engaged in Barcelona a couple weeks ago. We went on this tour for his birthday. Agnes was our our leader and she was amazing! She was fun, quirky and had great knowledge about the tour itself and the wine we tasted. This was definitely a highlight of our trip and we will recommend this to our friends and family travelling to Barcelona soon!

This tour is amazing, everything from start to finish was organised, informative and fun. Our tour guide Agnes was so knowledgeable and also great fun. The tapas and wine experience was also super fun and the wines were all delicious. One of the best tours we have done in all of our years of travel. Highly recommended for a great day out!

This tour was perfect for us. Montserrat is beautiful. The winery was very interesting. Ana did an excellent job! she was fun and very knowledgeable. She was patient with all questions. This is a great tour if you want to get out of the city. The countryside is breathtaking. The tapas that went along with the wine tasting were plentiful. There is also an opportunity to snack at the Monastery. I highly recommend this tour.

The tours was very nice.
Pol is a wonderful guide and by far the best I ever add!!!!!

We really had a lovely day and we both loved all the information we had and all the little attention to make us feel special.
This was one of our highlights of our trip to Spain. Our tour guide Xavi was amazing, informative, fun and energetic. I highly recommend this tour even with teens.

People were (guides) very friendly and helpful. Bus ride Ann hour but very comfortable. Once arriving the views were breath taking. We didn't know about the black Madonna so it was great to hear the story. Walk to the cross at the top of the mountain. Steep but worth it. Hey some bread the buns make.

Winery was historical. The wine tasting was very informative. Or guide Carol was very knowledgeable and friendly.

This tour was fanastico! Montserrat is a nice excursion in and of itself, with its old and newer old world charm and scenic surroundings. I enjoyed the tour of Montserrat, the personal time spent hiking and trying local liquors and treats, and 2nd leg of the tour to the vineyard and winery for tapas and winetasting. The tapas were enough for me for lunch, though this may have been helped because the day was warm.

Dani was a fantastic tour guide; he's energetic, he enjoys and gives good humor, he's personable, and is knowledgable with history, wines, and the region in general.

While I was unusually traveling alone, I had a great time getting to know the people in our small group!

At home, we've got elementary through high school aged kids. I'd recommend it for tweens and teens who like adventure and to be on the go, though it may be a long day for kids younger than this. The wine tasting, also, may not be of high interest for kiddos, though they may like the experience of being in a vineyard and historic winery. As with everything, interest will depend on the individual child. If you've got younger kids, check age restrictions before signing up.

I'd go again in a heartbeat. Thanks Dani!

Thoroughly enjoyed our day trip to Montserrat monastery and the winery. It was well organised, transport was comfortable and the food and wine tasty. Our tour guide Ana was very friendly and knowledgeable. The number of people in the group was small and so we felt very well cared for. Highly recommend this trip as a way to venture outside Barcelona.

What an incredible experience! From the train, to the wine, to the incredible knowledge of the guide - everything was wonderful. Specifically, though, Aurora went above and beyond to learn people's names, what they liked and connecting the conversation to them, and simply made the experience unforgettable. Thank you!

We had an amazing day, my wife and I, daughter and her partner. We were collected in a very central location near to the Hard Rock Café so it was very easy to locate and find.
The coach was airconditioned which on such a hot day was very pleasant and the seating was comfortable too. Danny introduced us to some history and highlights as we departed Barcelona for Monserrat.
Monserrat is absolutely stunning and really worthwhile visiting in your lifetime. The monastery, history, mountains and scenery well - we could go on and on about it.
We enjoyed the tasting and free sweet bread. The local farmers market is excellent and we bought some excellent cheese.
We then left Monserrat via the coach, we took the train up the mountain on the way up. The wine tour was perfect with the amazing Tapas and of course the tastings, we hope to locate a couple of bottles to partake in over here too. The tour was very interesting along with experiencing the castle and the family history here. The return journey was very pleasant.
Our tour guide Borja was excellent in every way, knowledgeable, personable and very patient and understanding. We would highly recommend Borja as a tourguide.
Do go on this tour it is very worthwhile and worth the investment.

Our guide Agnes was a delight! Very enthusiastic and excellent guide. We totally enjoyed this excursion (we got back around 3:30, I think the all day tour may have been too long). This allowed plenty of time to relax and prepare for evening fun. I totally recommend the visit to the monastery and the winery -- both are beautiful and not to be missed!

This was our first time in Barcelona. If we were only in Barcelona for one or two days, we would probably not have done this tour, but we had a third day and signed up. We were happy we did! We enjoyed getting to see the beautiful views from the monastery. This was a neat place to see. Afterwards, we toured the winery. We go all over to places like Napa in the US for wine tours, so are very familiar. This tour did not stand out per say, nor did their wine, but the winery does have some history and the wine was very drinkable. The tapas were nice, which we all enjoyed as a group. My only complaint was that our guide was not very knowledgeable about wine, it's history or how it's made. You also see that they have one tour group coming in while another is going out at the winery.

We were there on Father's Day. What a unique and wonderful place. We loved the wine tasting after. Our tour guide was very friendly and extremely knowledgable about Montserrat as well as wines and the region in general. Dont miss and spend the money to do the tour plus wine tasting.

We did the lunch option of the wine tour and our tour guide was Aurora. She was so funny, knowledgeable and you could tell she really loved and enjoyed her job. This made for such a wonderful experience, from viewing Monsterrat, the lunch and the wine tour. Aurora took her time to explain everything, showing her love and compassion for the region. She had the group laughing the whole time and it really was such a fun day, enjoying the culture, views and food and wine of the region! Definitely do this if you are looking to do a day trip outside of Barcelona.

My husband and I came here for one stop on our honeymoon and it was an amazing experience! Our tour guide Agnes was the BEST! She was so knowledgable, funny, and made sure that we all had a great time.

On our last full day in Barcelona, we decided to do an excursion to Montserrat. Our guide, Ana, was super friendly and very knowledgeable. We took a bus up to Montserrat and took a cogwheel train up to the monastery. We started off with tasting local liquors in the gift shop. They also gave us delicious fresh bread topped with fine sugar. This was a nice start and opened up to free time to explore the monastery. The views from the grounds are breathtaking and worth the trip alone to see! We got to hear the boys choir sing and, if you want, you can get in line to touch the famous Black Madonna. There is also a nice art museum on the grounds, but that entrance fee wasn’t included with our tour. Hearing the bells ring and resonate against the tall rock formations was something I’ll never forget! From there, we got on another bus and headed to Oller del Mas winery. The winery is in a 10th century castle and the grounds offer s stunning view of the serrated mountains in the distance. Ana gave us a sample of wines outside in a covered patio. Afterwards, we headed into the castle to enjoy our tapas lunch and wine pairing. The winery is organic and it was impressive to hear all the guidelines they must follow to keep that distinction. The tapas were generous and delicious and the wines were all top-notch. Ana was able to answer all questions people had about each place we visited. She also gave information as we passed other sights not on our tour in case we visited in our own later. This was a wonderful and relaxed tour of places very rich in culture and history. I highly recommend this tour! Thanks again, Ana!

The Monserrat tour with tapas and wine tasting was excellent. Our tour guide, Albert, was knowledgeable, friendly and able to answer all our questions. The wines were superb and the tapas very tasty. We were very glad to spend most of our day on this tour.
Perfect day trip away from Barcelona to explore more of what Spain has to offer! Miguel was a fantastic guide.
Wonderful tour of Monserrat. Excellent tour guide Xavier. Great sense of humour. Wine @ tapas tasting was so nice. Excellent knowledge by tour guide of district and winery issues.

Myself and my girlfriend went in this trip. I’ve been to Barcelona many times but never done a day trip. This was extremely enjoyable. Very relaxed. Good company. The tour guide Xavi was great. Very helpful and full of enthusiasm. The winery was a really enjoyable experience. Overall great value for money and a day well spent. I would definitely recommend you take this tour.

We went on this tour not being sure what to expect. Clara was extremely informed and very funny! The bus was very comfortable and we had a really great time! Clara spoke like 5 different languages and went out of her way to interact with everyone individually to make sure we all felt comfortable and attended to. I would really recommend this tour for anyone looking to do something outside the city. I look forward to coming back again! Delicious wine wish i could have brought more back with me!

Albert was our tour guide, well informed, kind and TALL, Never had to wonder where my group was!! He really knew his stuff--while each guide has their basic script, he was always able to answer any questions thrown at him with knowledge and poise.
We took a bus to the mountains where we then boarded a train up the mountain. You never saw such beautiful views. The wine and tapas were just the icing on the cake of what was a very worthwhile day.
From the time we started everything was the best- Aurora was fun and knowledgeable - the sites were magnificent - the lunch and wine tasting supurb - I would recommend this tour to anyone .

We had the pleasure of joining a group of 15 led by Sandra.

We did the Montserrat trip combined with a castle side-trip to a vineyard.

Our guide Sandra was extremely knowledgeable and pleasant and we thoroughly enjoyed the historical aspect of this trip.

The wine, the tapas and the views at Montserrat will be forever etched in my mind. Well worth the time and money. Having a guide saves you so much time and aggravation at Monserrat.

By far the most beautiful views whether your on the mountain or at the castle/ winery.
Our guide Dani was so knowledgeable about the history of Spain and did a fantastic job explaining this area of Spain. You can tell he loves where his from. Every part of the tour was first class. I highly recommend this tour.

We loved our tour with Sandra! She was so knowledgeable and personable. It was a cold day in March when we went on our tour and were lucky enough to see snow on the mountain, which was beautiful. The only downside is that we couldn't be there for longer! Would definitely recommend!

A great trip to Montserrat and the vineyard. Dani our guide was the best. He gave us the facts of the region in an interesting way. He was there until the end of the trip to help us with anything we needed. Our experience with Montserrat was just amazing, the breathtaking view at the top was priceless! Glad we made the funicular ride. Also the local products from the little market was very good. The tapas and wine session in the afternoon was filled with fun and laughter in the middle aged castle. We had a great group together from different parts of the world. We highly recommend this trip!

We joined this tour just this past Sunday and were very impressed with the organization and the tour guides. We were with Jordi's group and he was superb both in his knowledge of the area, attractions and the activities. The other guides also provided great insight on the bus ride up the mountain. Easily an excursion we'd recommend to others!
Excellent tour. Well organised. Guides are knowledgeable and friendly. All of the timings were good. Couldn't identify the wine aged in a cinnamon barrel

My wife and I went on the tour with Pol and it was an excellent experience. He was very knowledgeable of the monastery and provided a great history as well as an excellent explanation on wine making in the Catalunya region. We had a great lunch and the wine was amazing! Make sure you wear comfortable clothes and shoes as there is a lot of walking/hiking if you chose to explore Montserrat beyond the monastery. Highly recommended as a day trip outside of Barcelona

Three of us took this tour with very different expectations. My interest was the Black Madonna while my husband loves wine and food. Our friend is a photographer and is always looking for the ultimate landscape. Jordi did a fantastic job of meeting all our expectations. He gave us plenty of time at Montserrat to choose to visit the wine and cheese store, go to a very good art museum there, take two funiculars, and enjoy the cathedral with the madonna, mass, and boys' choir. With his background in wine, we particularly enjoyed the winery tour and luncheon. Good fun, great opportunity to meet other travelers, and very professional approach by Madrid Tapas. Thank you!

My tour guide was Jordi and he was awesome. Very funny and a great guide -- he really seemed to be passionate about wine. Montserrat was absolutely beautiful and I wish I had spent a full day there. I liked all the wines we tasted and the tapas were quite nice.

Four of us (2 couples) booked this tour with Viator. We had a small group of 11, which was fabulous (great group of people, too). Our guide was Carol, and she was tremendous: personable, efficient, friendly, and super informative. When we sign up for tours, we WANT to be informed. Her commentary was perfect -- we learned a lot from Carol, and she was enthusiastic and had a great sense of humor. We were also lucky to have wonderful weather (on the chilly side - end of February 2018 but bright sunshine). We enjoyed the cog train ride to Montserrat, as well as the liquor tasting there. We had plenty of time to explore on our own, including walking up/back to/from the lookout point. We thoroughly enjoyed the winery and tapas (probably a bit more than Montserrat). My non-dairy/no meat dietary restrictions were honored -- my food was yummy. We got to taste 2 white and 2 red wines. Carol was a great guide for the wine tasting/tour, too. We highly recommend this tour, and hopefully you will have Carol as your guide. Note: I was not able to post a review on Viator because our friends booked the tour with their Viator account.
Xavi was our excellent guide, very informative. Definitely recommend this tour. Finished off the day with some excellent wine.

Marta was an excellent tour guide. We went with a big group of friends, in our early twenties, and she made the tour engaging and fun. She gave us plenty of time to explore Montserrat and was very detailed and entertaining while explaining the place to us. The tour itself was amazing as well. Montserrat was beautiful and the wine tasting and tapas was excellent too.

We loved Marta as our guide!
Great day trip from Barcelona. Montserrat is beautiful even when the weather isn't perfect. This tour is a great way to get everything in. Carol was very personable and knowledgeable.

My friend and I took the tour and had a great time. Pol was a great guide. Very knowledgeable, personable, and fun. Montserrat was gorgeous. The winery was beautiful as well. Pol did a great job explaining the process of wine and why that winery was different from the rest. I would highly recommend this tour.

Our guide Xavi was a lot of fun. He made us all feel comfortable. The tour was worth it. Although it was a Sunday and Monserrat was very crowded even in the off season , we experienced all there was to see in Monserrat. The visit to Oller Del Mas Winery was worthwhile. We bought several bottles of wine there at reasonable prices!

Where to start? Firstly, our guide Jordi was amazing. He is very knowledgeable and fun. His interactions with our small group over lunch made it feel like we were a little family. The tour up to montserrat was breath taking. I have never been in a cog train before this. We got to try local cheeses and liquors and were given ample free time to explore. Jordi even gave us suggestions on available activities. Lunch at the country club was very large and tasty. The wine tasting at the castle was a lovely way to end the trip. Again Jordi was knowledgeable and made the wine tasting fun rather than formal. Definitely recommend this tour.
We had a great time on this tour. Marta is very knowledgable and funny. Would definitely take another tour if we go back to Barcelona. Hopefully we can get Marta as a guide again.

We will book this tour again for our return to Barcelona in the spring of 2018! Truly enjoyed the entire experience from the wealth of information shared on the bus ride to Montserrat to the tour throughout the entire experience. Our guide, Marta, was a wealth of knowledge and included great humor in the day. We hope to get her again on our next trip up the mountain!

What a great tour group! Well organized and the entire team works well together. We opted for the Montserrat Tour with Tapas and wine. Marta was our guide and she was absolutely wonderful. Her knowledge of Monserrat and the winery was nothing less than stellar. Her enthusiasm and sense of humor was also a plus. I would highly recommend this tour and this company to anyone visiting Barcelona. You won’t regret it.
I would also like to thank James the Concierge at the Cotton House for this wonderful recommendation that perfectly suited our needs.
My family had a wonderful time on this tour. Our guide Xavi was amazing. Monterrat, food, and wine = a wonderful day. Well worth the money and time to do this day trip.

Great experience, loved every minute of it and appreciated the information and free time to explore Montserrat. The Tapas were great too. Our tour guide was called Xavi and he was amazing, once of the best tour guides I've had.

This was a very enjoyable day trip that exceeded our expectations although we could have spent some more time on the mountain but then we wouldn't have enough time for the wine tasting! A real toss-up ;-)
Ana was a fabulous and very knowledgable guide and so were the other two guides that also travelled on the bus with us. We really appreciated the small groups since the whole group of 26 was broken up into 3 groups (hence the 3 guides on the bus). I enjoyed the various modes of travelling, bus from Barcelona and back and using the cogwheel train up to the monastery. The liquor tasting up,there was very good and the wine tasting at a castle winery, 4 wines with cheese and tapas, was delicious and plentiful. Ana's knowledge of the wines and the history of the castle/family enhanced the experience. All together a very worthwhile experience I would recommend to anyone (good bang for your buck!)
Gertrude, Vancouver Island, Canada

This was probably the best tour we took while in Barcelona. I was hesitant on visiting the monastery thinking it would be a bit boring but thanks to our excellent tour guide Clara I very much enjoyed it. Wonderful 1/2 day tour. Felt like you didn't need a full day. Perfect amount of time to see Montserrat and enjoy lunch at a exceptional vineyard.
